description.en-US: Stops execution of the action list if at least one condition in the condition list is false. If all conditions are true, execution continues with the next action.
description.zh-CN: 如果条件列表中至少有一项条件为“假”，则停止执行动作列表。如果所有条件均为“真”，则继续执行下一条动作。

description.en-US: Stops execution of the action list if all conditions in the condition list are true. If any are false, execution continues with the next action.
description.zh-CN: 如果条件列表中所有条件均为“真”，则停止执行动作列表。如果有任何一条为“假”，则继续执行下一条动作。

description.en-US: Denotes the beginning of a series of actions that will execute in a loop, modifying the control variable on each loop. The corresponding end action denotes the end of the loop. If the control variable reaches or passes the range stop value, then the loop exits, and execution jumps to the next action after the end action.
description.zh-CN: 表示在循环中执行的一系列行动的开始, 并在每次循环时修改控制变量的值. 当前级别中的下一个end行动表示循环的结束. 如果执行至循环顶部时, 控制条件达到或超过终止值, 则退出循环, 跳至end操作之后的下一个操作执行.

params.en-US: The player whose variable is being modified in this loop. If multiple players are specified, the first player is used.
The variable being modified in this loop. It is set to the range start value when the loop begins, and the loop continues until the control variable reaches or passes the range stop value.
The control variable is set to this value when the loop begins.

If the control variable reaches or passes this value, then the loop will exit, and execution jumps to the next action after the end action. Whether this value is considered passed or not is based on whether the step value is negative or positive. If the control variable has already reached or passed this value when the loop begins, then the loop exits.

This value is added to the control variable when the end action is reached. If this modification causes the control variable to reach or pass the range stop value, then the loop exits, and execution jumps to the next action after the end action. Otherwise, the loop continues, and execution jumps to the next action after the for action.

description.en-US: Restarts the action list from the beginning if at least one condition in the condition list is false. If all conditions are true, execution continues with the next action.
description.zh-CN: 如果条件列表中至少有一项条件为“假”，则从头开始执行动作列表。如果所有条件均为“真”，则执行下一项动作。

description.en-US: Stops execution of the action list.
description.zh-CN: 停止执行动作列表。

description.en-US: Stops execution of the action list if this action's condition evaluates to true. If it does not, execution continues with the next action.
description.zh-CN: 如果此动作的条件为“真”，则停止执行动作列表。否则，则继续执行下一条动作。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the execution is stopped.
params.zh-CN: 是否停止执行。

description.en-US: Adds a temporary health pool to a player or players. This health pool can be referenced using the Last Created Health Pool value. Up to 16 health pools of a given health type (health, armor, or shields) may exist on a player (including base pools and pools generated by abilities).
description.zh-CN: 为一名或多名玩家添加临时的生命池。如果要指定此生命池，可以使用“上一个创建的生命池”值。同一名玩家身上任意一个生命值类型（生命、护甲或护盾）的生命池最多可以存在16个（包括基本生命池和由技能获得的生命池）。

params.en-US: The player or players whose movement collision is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的移动碰撞将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies the type of health (Armor or shields) contained in the Health Pool.
params.zh-CN: 指定此生命池中所包含的生命值类型（护甲或护盾）。

params.en-US: The size of the health pool
params.zh-CN: 生命池的数值。

params.en-US: Whether health in this pool can be healed once it is lost. If this is value is false, then the health pool will shrink and disappear as it is damaged.
params.zh-CN: 此生命池中的生命在失去后是否可以由治疗恢复。如果此值为假，则此生命值在受到伤害后会削减并消失。

params.en-US: If set to true and Recoverable is also true, then Max Health will be reevaluated every frame. Else, Max Health is only evaluated once when this action executes.
params.zh-CN: 如果此值为真，且“可恢复”为真，则每一帧都会重新为“最大生命值”赋值。如果此值为假或“可恢复”为假，则“最大生命值”只会在此行动执行时被赋值一次。

description.en-US: Modifies the score (kill count) of one or more players. This action only has an effect in free-for-all modes.
description.zh-CN: 修改一名或多名玩家的分数（击杀数）。此动作只会在自由混战模式中生效。

params.en-US: The player or players whose score will change.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的分数将被改变。

params.en-US: The amount the score will increase or decrease. If positive, the score will increase. If negative, the score will decrease.
params.zh-CN: 增加或减少的分数。如果为正数则增加分数，为负数则减少分数。

description.en-US: Modifies the score of one or both teams. This action has no effect in free-for-all modes or modes without a team score.
description.zh-CN: 改变一方或双方队伍的分数。此动作在自由混战模式或没有队伍分数的模式中无效。

params.en-US: The team or teams whose score will be changed.
params.zh-CN: 要改变分数的队伍。

params.en-US: The amount the score will increase or decrease. If positive, the score will increase. If negative, the score will decrease.
params.zh-CN: 增加或减少的分数。如果为正数则增加分数，为负数则减少分数。

description.en-US: Undoes the effect of the disallow button action for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 取消“禁用按钮”动作的效果。

params.en-US: The player or players whose button is being reenabled.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的按钮将重新启用。

params.en-US: The logical button that is being reenabled.
params.zh-CN: 将要重新启用的逻辑按键。

description.en-US: Applies an instantaneous change in velocity to the movement of one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 立即使一名或多名玩家的移动速度发生改变。

params.en-US: The player or players whose velocity will be changed.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的速度将被改变。

params.en-US: The unit direction in which the impulse will be applied. This value is normalized internally.
params.zh-CN: 施加推力的单位方向。此值将进行内部归一化。

params.en-US: The magnitude of the change to the velocities of the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 玩家速度改变的数值。

params.en-US: Specifies whether direction is relative to world coordinates or the local coordinates of the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 确定此方向是相对于地图坐标还是玩家的本地坐标。

params.en-US: Specifies whether existing velocity that is counter to direction should first be cancelled out before applying the impulse.
params.zh-CN: 确定在施加推力前是否首先消除已有的与此方向相反的速度。

description.en-US: Attaches the player (the 'child') to another player (the 'parent'). Once attached, the child will be unable to move freely until detached or teleported away. Multiple children may be attached to the same parent, but not vice versa.
description.zh-CN: 将一名玩家（子玩家）与另一名玩家（父玩家）绑定。绑定之后，除非解除绑定或传送离开，否则子玩家无法自由移动。多个子玩家可以绑定至同一名父玩家，但反之则不成立。

params.en-US: The player that will attach to the parent. This player will be unable to move freely until detached or teleported away.
params.zh-CN: 将此玩家绑定至父玩家。在解除绑定或传送离开之前，此玩家无法自由移动。

params.en-US: The player to whom the child will attach. This player's movement will be unaffected and will determine the child's position.
params.zh-CN: 将子玩家绑定至此玩家。此玩家本身的动作不受影响，而其行动会决定子玩家的位置。

params.en-US: The coordinates of the child relative to the parent. For example, Vector(1, 2, 0) would be above and to the left of the parent's head.
params.zh-CN: 子玩家与父玩家的相对坐标。例如，矢量 (1, 2, 0) 指示的是父玩家头顶左边的位置。

description.en-US: Displays a large message above the reticle that is visible to specific players.
description.zh-CN: 在准星上方显示大字体信息，对指定玩家可见。

params.en-US: One or more players who will see the message.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将看到此信息。

params.en-US: The message to be displayed.
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的信息。

description.en-US: Skips to the end of the innermost loop.
description.zh-CN: 表示一个中止当前While或For循环的动作。跳至End动作后的下一个动作继续执行。

description.en-US: Cancels the active abilities for one or more players. Equivalent to a short stun.
description.zh-CN: 取消一名或多名玩家启动技能的设置。

params.en-US: The player or players to cancel active abilities for.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的启动技能将取消。

description.en-US: Gradually modifies the value of a global variable at a specific rate. (A global variable is a variable that belongs to the game itself.)
description.zh-CN: 以指定的速率逐步改变一个全局变量的值，全局变量即属于游戏本身的变量。

params.en-US: Specifies which global variable to modify gradually.
params.zh-CN: 指定要改变的全局变量。

params.en-US: The value that the global variable will eventually reach. The type of this value may be either a number or a vector, though the variable's existing value must be of the same type before the chase begins.
params.zh-CN: 该全局变量最后达到的值。这个值的类型可以是数字或矢量，然而必须与追踪开始时全局变量所具有的值相同。

params.en-US: The amount of change that will happen to the variable's value each second.
params.zh-CN: 此变量的值每秒改变的量。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Gradually modifies the value of a global variable over time. (A global variable is a variable that belongs to the game itself.)
description.zh-CN: 逐渐改变一个全局变量的值，全局变量即属于游戏本身的变量。

params.en-US: Specifies which global variable to modify gradually.
params.zh-CN: 指定要改变的全局变量。

params.en-US: The value that the global variable will eventually reach. The type of this value may be either a number or a vector, though the variable's existing value must be of the same type before the chase begins.
params.zh-CN: 该全局变量最后达到的值。这个值的类型可以是数字或矢量，然而必须与追踪开始时全局变量所具有的值相同。

params.en-US: The amount of time, in seconds, over which the variable's value will approach the destination.
params.zh-CN: 变量到达最终值所用的时间，以秒为单位。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Gradually modifies the value of a player variable at a specific rate. (A player variable is a variable that belongs to a specific player.)
description.zh-CN: 以指定的速率逐步改变一个玩家变量的值，玩家变量即属于一个特定玩家的变量。

params.en-US: The player whose variable will gradually change. If multiple players are provided, each of their variables will change independently.
params.zh-CN: 此玩家的变量将被逐渐改变。如果有多个玩家，则每个玩家的变量都将各自被改变。

params.en-US: Specifies which of the player's variables to modify gradually.
params.zh-CN: 指定将要改变的玩家变量。

params.en-US: The value that the player variable will eventually reach. The type of this value may be either a number or a vector, though the variable's existing value must be of the same type before the chase begins.
params.zh-CN: 该玩家变量最后达到的值。这个值的类型可以是数字或矢量，然而必须与追踪开始时玩家变量所具有的值相同。

params.en-US: The amount of change that will happen to the variable's value each second.
params.zh-CN: 此变量的值每秒改变的量。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Gradually modifies the value of a player variable over time. (A player variable is a variable that belongs to a specific player.)
description.zh-CN: 逐步改变一个玩家变量的值，玩家变量即属于一个特定玩家的变量。

params.en-US: The player whose variable will gradually change. If multiple players are provided, each of their variables will change independently.
params.zh-CN: 此玩家的变量将被逐渐改变。如果有多个玩家，则每个玩家的变量都将各自被改变。

params.en-US: Specifies which of the player's variables to modify gradually.
params.zh-CN: 指定将要改变的玩家变量。

params.en-US: The value that the player variable will eventually reach. The type of this value may be either a number or a vector, though the variable's existing value must be of the same type before the chase begins.
params.zh-CN: 该玩家变量最后达到的值。这个值的类型可以是数字或矢量，然而必须与追踪开始时玩家变量所具有的值相同。

params.en-US: The amount of time, in seconds, over which the variable's value will approach the destination.
params.zh-CN: 变量到达最终值所用的时间，以秒为单位。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Clears a status that was applied from a set status action from one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 清除一个或多个玩家身上由“设置状态”动作施加的一个状态。

params.en-US: The player or players from whom the status will be removed.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的状态将被清除。

params.en-US: The status to be removed from the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 从指定玩家身上清除的状态。

description.en-US: Causes one or more players to use an emote, voice line, or other equipped communication.
description.zh-CN: 使一名或多名玩家使用一个表情、语音或其他已装备的方式进行交流。

params.en-US: The player or players to perform the communication.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将自动开始交流。

params.en-US: The type of communication.
params.zh-CN: 交流的类型。

description.en-US: Goes back to the start of the innermost loop.
description.zh-CN: 表示一个跳至当前While或For循环起始处继续执行的动作。

description.en-US: Creates an in-world beam effect entity. This effect entity will persist until destroyed. To obtain a reference to this entity, use the last created entity value. This action will fail if too many entities have been created.
description.zh-CN: 创建一个地图中的光束效果实体。此实体会持续至消除为止。如果想引用此实体，可使用“上一个创建的实体”的返还值。如果已创建了太多的实体，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: One or more players who will be able to see the effect.
params.zh-CN: 一名或多名将家将可以看到此效果。

params.en-US: The type of effect to be created.
params.zh-CN: 将要创建的效果类型。启用特定地图工坊扩展可添加新的选项。

params.en-US: The effect's start position. If this value is a player, then the effect will move along with the player. Otherwise, the value is interpreted as a position in the world.
params.zh-CN: 效果开始的位置。如果此值为一名玩家，那么效果将随此玩家移动。否则，此值将代表地图中的一个位置。

params.en-US: The effect's end position. If this value is a player, then the effect will move along with the player. Otherwise, the value is interpreted as a position in the world.
params.zh-CN: 效果终点所在的位置。如果此值为一名玩家，那么该效果将与玩家一起移动。否则，此值将代表地图中的一个位置。

params.en-US: The color of the beam to be created. If a particular team is chosen, the effect will either be red or blue, depending on whether the team is hostile to the viewer. Does not apply to sound effects. Only the "good" and "bad" beam effects can have color applied.
params.zh-CN: 所创建效果的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。不会影响音效，只会影响“有益”或“有害”的光束效果。不支持自定义颜色。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The effect will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此效果会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Adds a new bot to the specified slot on the specified team so long as the slot is available. This bot will only move, fire, or use abilities if executing workshop actions.
description.zh-CN: 在指定队伍的指定栏位添加一个新的机器人（只要该空位可用）。机器人只能移动与射击，或根据地图工坊的动作设置使用技能。启用相应地图工坊扩展可额外创建更多机器人。

params.en-US: The hero that the bot will be. If more than one hero is provided, one will be chosen at random.
params.zh-CN: 机器人使用的英雄。如果提供了多于一个英雄，则会随机在其中选择。

params.en-US: The team on which to create the bot. The "all" option only works in free-for-all game modes, while the "team" options only work in team-based game modes.
params.zh-CN: 将机器人添加至此队伍。“全部”选项只适用于自由混战模式，“队伍”选项只适用于基于队伍的游戏模式。

params.en-US: The player slot which will receive the bot (-1 for first available slot). Up to 6 bots may be added to each team, or 12 bots to the free-for-all team, regardless of lobby settings.
params.zh-CN: 在此玩家栏位添加机器人（-1表示第一个可用的空位）。不管游戏大厅中的设置如何，每支队伍最多可以加入6个机器人，自由混战队伍中最多可加入12个机器人。

params.en-US: The initial position where the bot will appear.
params.zh-CN: 机器人最初出现的位置。

params.en-US: The initial direction that the bot will face.
params.zh-CN: 假人最初面向的方向。

description.en-US: Creates an in-world effect entity. This effect entity will persist until destroyed. To obtain a reference to this entity, use the last created entity value. This action will fail if too many entities have been created.
description.zh-CN: 创建一个地图中的效果实体。此实体会持续至消除为止。如果想指定此实体，可使用“上一个创建的实体”的返还值。如果已创建了太多的实体，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: One or more players who will be able to see the effect.
params.zh-CN: 一名或多名玩家将可以看到此效果.

params.en-US: The type of effect to be created.
params.zh-CN: 将要创建的效果类型。启用特定地图工坊扩展可添加新的选项。

params.en-US: The color of the effect to be created. If a particular team is chosen, the effect will either be red or blue, depending on whether the team is hostile to the viewer. Does not apply to sound effects. Does not support Custom Color.
params.zh-CN: 所创建效果的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。对声音效果无效。不支持自定义颜色。

params.en-US: The effect's position. If this value is a player, then the effect will move along with the player. Otherwise, the value is interpreted as a position in the world.
params.zh-CN: 效果终点所在的位置。如果此值为一名玩家，那么该效果将与玩家一起移动。否则，此值将代表地图中的一个位置。

params.en-US: The radius of this effect.
params.zh-CN: 效果的半径，单位为米。对声音效果则影响其音量。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Creates a projectile entity that either heals or damages players and player-owned entities. The projectile follows the provided target with variable strength. This action will fail if too many entities have been created.
description.zh-CN: 创建一个弹道实体，可对玩家或玩家拥有的实体造成治疗或伤害。弹道会按强度变量追踪给定目标。如果已创建了太多的实体，此动作可能会失效。

params.en-US: The type of projectile to be created. New options can be added to this list by enabling the Projectiles workshop extension.
params.zh-CN: 所创建弹道的类型。启用弹道地图工坊扩展后可添加新的选项。

params.en-US: The player who owns this projectile and will receive credit for kills. If null, the projectile will be owned by nobody. The projectile will not affect its owner.
params.zh-CN: 拥有此弹道且会被归为击杀者的玩家。若为“空”，则弹道不被任何人拥有。弹道不会影响其拥有者。

params.en-US: The start position of the projectile. If null, the player's eye position will be used.
params.zh-CN: 弹道的起始位置。若为“空”，则使用玩家的眼睛位置。

params.en-US: The direction for the projectile to travel. If null, the player's facing direction will be used.
params.zh-CN: 弹道的行动方向。若为“空”，则使用玩家的面朝方向。

params.en-US: Whether the projectile's start position and direction are relative to the player or to the world.
params.zh-CN: 弹道的起始位置和行动方向是相对于玩家还是地图。

params.en-US: Whether the projectile will heal or damage targets it collides with.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道对碰撞目标造成的是治疗还是伤害。

params.en-US: Which team the projectile will collide with. The projectile will never affect its owner regardless of team.
params.zh-CN: 哪方队伍会被此弹道碰撞。不管弹道拥有者属于哪方队伍，弹道始终不会影响其拥有者。

params.en-US: The amount of damage or healing the projectile will apply to targets it collides with. If explosion radius is set to an amount greater than 0, this is how much damage the explosion will do at its center.
params.zh-CN: 对弹道碰撞目标造成的伤害或治疗量。如果“爆炸范围”设置为大于0，此数值表示爆炸对中心位置造成的伤害。

params.en-US: If explosion radius is set to 0 this is how much to scale the damage amount for critical hits. If the explosion radius is greater than 0 this is how much damage the projectile will do at the edge of the explosion.
params.zh-CN: 如果“爆炸范围”设置为0，此值表示暴击时伤害的缩放量。如果“爆炸范围”设置为大于0，此值表示弹道在爆炸边缘处造成的伤害值。

params.en-US: The radius of the explosion created by this projectile. If 0, this projectile doesn't create an explosion.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道所产生的爆炸范围。若为“0”，则弹道不会产生爆炸。

params.en-US: The effect to use when the projectile explodes. If explosion radius is 0 this effect will not be created.
params.zh-CN: 弹道爆炸时应用的效果。如果“爆炸范围”为0，则不会创建此效果。

params.en-US: The sound effect to use when the projectile explodes. If explosion radius is 0 this effect will not be created.
params.zh-CN: 弹道爆炸时应用的声音效果。如果“爆炸范围”为0，则不会创建此效果。

params.en-US: A 0 to 1 range for how oversized the projectile should be, 0 being the default size, 1 being the maximum allowed size. The maximum allowed size is different for each projectile type.
params.zh-CN: 此数值范围为0到1，表示该弹道尺寸增大的比例，0表示默认尺寸，1表示允许的最大尺寸。每种弹道类型允许的最大尺寸不同。

params.en-US: The speed in meters per second that the projectile will travel along its direction. (0.1 to 1000)
params.zh-CN: 弹道沿前进方向行动的速度，单位为米/秒。

params.en-US: How long in seconds before the projectile expires.
params.zh-CN: 弹道存在多少秒后消失。

params.en-US: The strength of the impulse to apply to a target when hit by this projectile. If explosion radius greater than 0, this impulse will applied to all targets affected by the explosion.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道击中目标时施加的推力。如果“爆炸范围”设置为大于0，此推力会施加给受爆炸影响的所有目标。

params.en-US: The homing target for the projectile. If null, the projectile will travel in a straight line.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道追踪的目标。如果为“空”，弹道会沿直线行动。

params.en-US: A 0 to 1 value representing how strongly the projectile will follow its target and how easily it will lose its target. At 0, the projectile won't follow its target at all, at 1, it will follow its target aggressively and never lose it.
params.zh-CN: 此数值范围为0到1，表示该弹道追踪目标的强度，以及跟丢目标的难易度。0表示弹道完全不会追踪目标，1表示弹道会积极追踪目标且绝不会跟丢。

description.en-US: Creates hud text visible to specific players at a specific location on the screen. This text will persist until destroyed. To obtain a reference to this text, use the Last Text ID value. This action will fail if too many text elements have been created.
description.zh-CN: 在指定玩家屏幕上的指定位置创建一条HUD文本。此文本会持续至消除为止。如果想指定此文本，可使用“上一个文本ID”的返还值。如果已创建了太多的文本元素，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: One or more players who will see the hud text.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将会看到这条HUD文本。

params.en-US: The text to be displayed (can be blank)
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的文本（可以为空）。

params.en-US: The subheader text to be displayed (can be blank)
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的子标题文本（可以为空）。

params.en-US: The body text to be displayed (can be blank)
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的正文文本（可以为空）。

params.en-US: The location on the screen where the text will appear.
params.zh-CN: 文本在屏幕上出现的位置。

params.en-US: The sort order of the text relative to other text in the same location. A higher sort order will come after a lower sort order.
params.zh-CN: 此文本与其他在同样位置的文本的排序关系。排序较高的文本会在排序较低的文本之后显示。

params.en-US: The color of the header.
params.zh-CN: 所创建标题文本的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

params.en-US: The color of the subheader.
params.zh-CN: 所创建子标题文本的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

params.en-US: The color of the text.
params.zh-CN: 所创建文本的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

params.en-US: Whether spectators can see the text or not.
params.zh-CN: 观战者是否可以看到此文本.

description.en-US: Creates an in-world icon entity. This icon entity will persist until destroyed. To obtain a reference to this entity, use the Last Created Entity value. This action will fail if too many entities have been created.
description.zh-CN: 创建一个地图中的图标实体。此实体会持续至消除为止。如果想指定此实体，可使用“上一个创建的实体”的返还值。如果已创建了太多的实体，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: One or more players who will be able to see the icon.
params.zh-CN: 一名或多名玩家将可以看到此图标。

params.en-US: The icon's position. If this value is a player, then the icon will appear above the player's head. Otherwise, the value is interpreted as a position in the world.
params.zh-CN: 图标所在的位置。如果此值为一名玩家，那么图标将显示在这名玩家的头顶上方。否则，此值将代表地图中的一个位置。

params.en-US: The icon to be created.
params.zh-CN: 将要创建的图标。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The icon will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的哪个输入值将持续被重新赋值。此图标会一直要求并采用重新赋值所传入的值。

params.en-US: The color of the icon to be created. If a particular team is chosen, the effect will either be red or blue, depending on whether the team is hostile to the viewer.
params.zh-CN: 所创建图标的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

params.en-US: Should this icon appear even when it is behind you?
params.zh-CN: 当此图标在你背后时是否显示？

params.en-US: The text's scale.
params.zh-CN: 文本的大小。

params.zh-CN: 指定地图文本使用的颜色

params.zh-CN: 所创建进度条文本的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

description.en-US: Creates a projectile entity that either heals or damages players and player-owned entities. This action will fail if too many entities have been created.
description.zh-CN: 创建一个弹道实体，可对玩家或玩家拥有的实体造成治疗或伤害。如果已创建了太多的实体，此动作可能会失效。

params.en-US: The type of projectile to be created. New options can be added to this list by enabling the Projectiles workshop extension.
params.zh-CN: 所创建弹道的类型。启用弹道地图工坊扩展后可添加新的选项。

params.en-US: The player who owns this projectile and will receive credit for kills. If null, the projectile will be owned by nobody. The projectile will not affect its owner.
params.zh-CN: 拥有此弹道且会被归为击杀者的玩家。若为“空”，则弹道不被任何人拥有。弹道不会影响其拥有者。

params.en-US: The start position of the projectile. If null, the player's eye position will be used.
params.zh-CN: 弹道的起始位置。若为“空”，则使用玩家的眼睛位置。

params.en-US: The direction for the projectile to travel. If null, the player's facing direction will be used.
params.zh-CN: 弹道的行动方向。若为“空”，则使用玩家的面朝方向。

params.en-US: Whether the projectile's start position and direction are relative to the player or to the world.
params.zh-CN: 弹道的起始位置和行动方向是相对于玩家还是地图。

params.en-US: Whether the projectile will heal or damage targets it collides with.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道对碰撞目标造成的是治疗还是伤害。

params.en-US: Which team the projectile will collide with. The projectile will never affect its owner regardless of team.
params.zh-CN: 哪方队伍会被此弹道碰撞。不管弹道拥有者属于哪方队伍，弹道始终不会影响其拥有者。

params.en-US: The amount of damage or healing the projectile will apply to targets it collides with. If explosion radius is set to an amount greater than 0, this is how much damage the explosion will do at its center.
params.zh-CN: 对弹道碰撞目标造成的伤害或治疗量。如果“爆炸范围”设置为大于0，此数值表示爆炸对中心位置造成的伤害。

params.en-US: If explosion radius is set to 0 this is how much to scale the damage amount for critical hits. If the explosion radius is greater than 0 this is how much damage the projectile will do at the edge of the explosion.
params.zh-CN: 如果“爆炸范围”设置为0，此值表示暴击时伤害的缩放量。如果“爆炸范围”设置为大于0，此值表示弹道在爆炸边缘处造成的伤害值。

params.en-US: The radius of the explosion created by this projectile. If 0, this projectile doesn't create an explosion.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道所产生的爆炸范围。若为“0”，则弹道不会产生爆炸。

params.en-US: The effect to use when the projectile explodes. If explosion radius is 0 this effect will not be created.
params.zh-CN: 弹道爆炸时应用的效果。如果“爆炸范围”为0，则不会创建此效果。

params.en-US: The sound effect to use when the projectile explodes. If explosion radius is 0 this effect will not be created.
params.zh-CN: 弹道爆炸时应用的声音效果。如果“爆炸范围”为0，则不会创建此效果。

params.en-US: A 0 to 1 range for how oversized the projectile should be, 0 being the default size, 1 being the maximum allowed size. The maximum allowed size is different for each projectile type.
params.zh-CN: 此数值范围为0到1，表示该弹道尺寸增大的比例，0表示默认尺寸，1表示允许的最大尺寸。每种弹道类型允许的最大尺寸不同。

params.en-US: The speed in meters per second that the projectile will travel along its direction. (0.1 to 1000)
params.zh-CN: 弹道沿前进方向行动的速度，单位为米/秒。

params.en-US: How long in seconds before the projectile expires.
params.zh-CN: 弹道存在多少秒后消失。

params.en-US: The strength of the impulse to apply to a target when hit by this projectile. If explosion radius greater than 0, this impulse will applied to all targets affected by the explosion.
params.zh-CN: 此弹道击中目标时施加的推力。如果“爆炸范围”设置为大于0，此推力会施加给受爆炸影响的所有目标。

params.en-US: How many times the projectile will ricochet off the environment before expiring.
params.zh-CN: 弹道在环境中弹射多少次后消失。

params.en-US: The amount of gravity affecting the projectile, creating an arc. If negative, the projectile will arc upwards.
params.zh-CN: 影响此弹道的引力值，产生一道弧线。若为负值，则弹道会产生上抛弧线。

description.zh-CN: 创建一个地图中的弹道效果实体。此实体会持续至消失为止。如果想引用此实体，可使用“上一个创建的实体”的返回值。如果已创建了太多的实体，此动作可能会失效。

params.en-US: A 0 to 1 range for how oversized the projectile should be, 0 being the default size, 1 being the maximum allowed size. The maximum allowed size is different for each projectile type.

description.en-US: Applies instantaneous damage to one or more players, possibly killing the players.
description.zh-CN: 立刻为一名或多名玩家造成伤害，可能会杀死玩家。

params.en-US: The player or players who will receive damage.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将受到伤害。

params.en-US: The player who will receive credit for the damage. A damager of null indicates no player will receive credit.
params.zh-CN: 伤害视为此名玩家造成的。如果“伤害者”设置为“空”则此伤害不会归到任何玩家名下。

params.en-US: The amount of damage to apply. This amount may be modified by buffs, debuffs, or armor.
params.zh-CN: 造成的伤害量.此数值可能会受到增益、减益状态或护甲的影响.

description.en-US: Instantly ends the match in a draw. This action has no effect in free-for-all modes.
description.zh-CN: 立即结束比赛，且结果为平局。此动作在自由混战模式中无效。

description.en-US: Instantly ends the match with the specific player as the winner. This action only has an effect in free-for-all modes.
description.zh-CN: 立即结束比赛并指定一名玩家为胜利者。此动作只在自由混战模式中生效。

params.en-US: The winning player.
params.zh-CN: 获胜的玩家。

description.en-US: Declare a draw for the current round. This only works in the elimination game mode.
description.zh-CN: 宣布当前回合为平局。只在决斗先锋模式中可用。

description.en-US: Declare a team as the current round winner. This only works in the control and elimination game modes.
description.zh-CN: 宣布一支队伍为当前回合的胜利方。只在占领要点模式和决斗先锋模式中可用。

params.en-US: Round winning team
params.zh-CN: 本回合获胜队伍

params.en-US: The winning team.
params.zh-CN: 获胜队伍。

description.zh-CN: 从比赛中移除所有机器人。

description.zh-CN: 消除所有由“创建效果”或“创建光束效果”所创建的效果实体。

description.zh-CN: 消除由“创建HUD文本”动作所创建的所有HUD文本。

description.zh-CN: 消除所有由“创建图标”所创建的图标实体。

description.zh-CN: 消除所有“创建地图文本”所创建的所有地图文本。

params.zh-CN: 移除此队伍中的机器人。“全部”选项只适用于自由混战模式，“队伍”选项只适用于基于队伍的游戏模式。

params.en-US: The slot to remove the dummy bot from.
params.zh-CN: 移除此栏位的机器人。

description.en-US: Destroys hud text that was created by create hud text.
description.zh-CN: 消除由“创建HUD文本”所创建的HUD文本。

params.zh-CN: 指定要消除的HUD文本。此ID可以是“上一个文本ID”，或一个之前储存“上一个文本ID”的变量。

description.zh-CN: 消除通过“创建图标”所创建的一个图标实体。

description.zh-CN: 取消“隐藏信息”动作的效果。

params.en-US: The player or players who will have their messages enabled.

params.en-US: The Player or Players who will have their Voice Chat enabled.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的语音聊天将被启用。

description.zh-CN: 强制一名或多名玩家按下虚拟按键，持续一帧。

params.en-US: The player or players for whom the virtual button input will be forced.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将强制按下按键。

params.en-US: The button to be pressed.
params.zh-CN: 要按下的按键。

description.en-US: Returns the match to the assemble heroes phase of the game mode. Only works if the game is in progress.
description.zh-CN: 回到比赛模式的集结英雄阶段。只有在游戏正在进行中时生效。

description.en-US: Provides an instantaneous heal to one or more players. This heal will not resurrect dead players.
description.zh-CN: 立刻为一名或多名玩家恢复生命值。此治疗效果不会复活已死亡的玩家。

params.en-US: The player or players whose health will be restored.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将恢复生命值。

params.zh-CN: 治疗视为此名玩家造成的。如果“治疗者”设置为“无”则此治疗不会归到任何玩家名下。

description.en-US: Instantly kills one or more players.

params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被杀死。

params.zh-CN: 击杀视为此名玩家造成的。如果“击杀者”设置为“空”则此击杀不会归到任何玩家名下。

params.zh-CN: 将要记入地图工坊查看器的字符串。

description.zh-CN: 从头开始执行动作列表。

description.zh-CN: 如果此动作的条件为“真”，则从头开始动作列表。否则，继续执行下一条动作。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the loop will occur.
params.zh-CN: 循环是否发生。

description.zh-CN: 如果条件列表中的每一项条件均为“真”，则从头开始执行动作列表。如果任意一项为“假”，则执行下一项动作。

description.en-US: Modifies the value of a global variable, which is a variable that belongs to the game itself.
description.zh-CN: 修改一个全局变量的值，全局变量即属于游戏本身的变量。

params.en-US: The global variable to modify.
params.zh-CN: 要修改的全局变量。

params.zh-CN: 变量的值改变的方式。选项包括标准运算操作，以及数组操作（如添加或移除值）。

params.en-US: The value used for the modification. For arithmetic operations, this is the second of the two operands, with the other being the variable's existing value. For array operations, this is the value to append or remove.
params.zh-CN: 用于修改的值。若要进行运算操作，则此值为两个运算量中的第二个，第一个运算量为变量当前的值。若要进行数组操作，则此值是用于添加或移除的值。

description.en-US: Modifies the value of a global variable at an index, which is a variable that belongs to the game itself.
description.zh-CN: 修改索引处一个全局变量的值，全局变量即属于游戏本身的变量。

params.zh-CN: 要修改的全局变量。

params.zh-CN: 修改数组的索引。如果索引位置已经超过了数组的末尾，则将数组延伸至索引位置，且新的元素值均为0。

params.en-US: The way in which the variable's value will be changed. Options include standard arithmetic operations as well as array operations for appending and removing values.
params.zh-CN: 变量的值改变的方式。选项包括标准运算操作，以及数组操作（如添加或移除值）。

params.en-US: The value used for the modification. For arithmetic operations, this is the second of the two operands, with the other being the variable's existing value. For array operations, this is the value to append or remove.

description.en-US: Modifies the value of a player variable at an index, which is a variable that belongs to a specific player.
description.zh-CN: 修改索引处一个玩家变量的值，玩家变量即属于一个特定玩家的变量。

params.en-US: The player whose variable will be modified. If multiple players are provided, each of their variables will be set.
params.zh-CN: 此玩家的变量将被修改。如果有多个玩家，则每个玩家的变量都将被设置。

params.en-US: Specifies which of the player's variables to modify.
params.zh-CN: 指定修改此玩家的哪些变量。

params.en-US: The index of the array to modify. If the index is beyond the end of the array, the array is extended with new elements given a value of zero.
params.zh-CN: 修改数组的索引。如果索引位置已经超过了数组的末尾，则将数组延伸至索引位置，且新的元素值均为0。

params.en-US: The way in which the variable's value will be changed. Options include standard arithmetic operations as well as array operations for appending and removing values.

description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家移动至指定队伍和栏位。指定栏位不可用时，此动作会失败。此动作对机器人无效。

params.en-US: The player or players to move.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被移动。

params.en-US: The team on which to move the Player. The "all" option only works in free-for-all game modes, while the "team" options only work in team-based game modes.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家移动至此队伍。“全部”选项只适用于自由混战模式，“队伍”选项只适用于基于队伍的游戏模式。

params.en-US: The player slot which will receive the player (-1 for first available slot).
params.zh-CN: 在此玩家栏位添加玩家（-1表示第一个可用的空位）。
