description.zh-CN: 在地图的指定位置播放一个效果。此效果的持续时间很短，所以不需要更新或消除。

params.en-US: One or more players who will be able to see the effect.
params.zh-CN: 一名或多名玩家将可以看到此效果.

params.en-US: The type of effect to be created.
params.zh-CN: 将要创建的效果类型。启用特定地图工坊扩展可添加新的选项。

params.en-US: The color of the effect to be created. If a particular team is chosen, the effect will either be red or blue, depending on whether the team is hostile to the viewer. Does not support Custom Color.
params.zh-CN: 所创建效果的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。不支持自定义颜色。

params.en-US: The effect's position. If this value is a player, then the effect will play at the player's position. Otherwise, the value is interpreted as a position in the world.
params.zh-CN: 效果所在位置。如果此值为一名玩家，那么效果将在此玩家所在位置播放。否则，此值将代表地图中的一个位置。

params.en-US: The effect's radius in meters.
params.zh-CN: 效果的半径，单位为米。对声音效果则影响其音量。

description.en-US: Preemptively loads the specified hero or heroes into memory using the skins of the specified player or players, available memory permitting.
description.zh-CN: 预先为指定的玩家将指定的英雄及皮肤加载入内存。当需要经常改变英雄且已知接下来要使用哪个英雄时适用。

params.en-US: The player or players who will begin preloading a hero or heroes. Only one preload hero action will be active at a time for a given player.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将开始预载一名或多名英雄。对每名玩家，同一时间只能有一个“预载英雄”动作生效。

params.en-US: The hero or heroes to begin preloading for the specified player or players. When multiple heroes are specified in an array, the heroes towards the beginning of the array are prioritized.
params.zh-CN: 为指定的玩家加载下列英雄.当选择了包含多个英雄的数组时,靠前的英雄将被优先加载.

description.en-US: Creates a progress bar HUD text visible to specified players at a specific location on the screen. This text will persist until destroyed. To obtain a reference to this text, use the getLastTextId() value. This action will fail if too many text elements have been created.
description.zh-CN: 在指定玩家屏幕上的指定位置创建一条进度条HUD文本。此文本会持续至消除为止。如果想指定此文本，可使用“上一个文本ID”的返还值。如果已创建了太多的文本元素，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: One or more players who will see the Progress Bar HUD text.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将会看到这条进度条HUD文本。

params.en-US: The value of the progress bar to be displayed as a percentage from 0 to 100.
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的进度条值，为从0到100的百分比。

params.en-US: The text to be displayed (can be blank)
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的文本（可以为空）。

params.en-US: The location on the screen where the text will appear.
params.zh-CN: 文本在屏幕上出现的位置。

params.en-US: The sort order of the text relative to other text in the same location. Text with a higher sort order will come after the text with a lower sort order.
params.zh-CN: 此文本与其他在同样位置的文本的排序关系。排序较高的文本会在排序较低的文本之后显示。

params.en-US: The color of the progress bar to be created. If a particular team is chosen, the effect will either be red or blue, depending on whether the team is hostile to the viewer.
params.zh-CN: 所创建进度条文本的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

params.en-US: The color of the text to be created. If a particular team is chosen, the effect will either be red or blue, depending on whether the team is hostile to the viewer.
params.zh-CN: 所创建文本的颜色。如果选择了一支队伍，此效果将显示为红色或蓝色，根据观察者是否与这支队伍敌对决定。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The text will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。这段文本会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

params.en-US: Whether spectators can see the text or not.
params.zh-CN: 无队伍观战者是否可以看到此文本。

description.en-US: Removes all health pools that were added to a player or players via the Add Health Pool action.
description.zh-CN: 移除由“添加生命池”行动添加的所有生命池。

params.en-US: The player or players whose added health pools will be removed.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家身上所添加的生命池将移除。

description.en-US: Removes one or more players from the custom game. This action doesn't work on dummy bots.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家移出自定游戏。此动作对机器人无效。

params.en-US: The player or players to remove.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被移除。

description.en-US: Removes a health pool that was added via the Add Health Pool action.
description.zh-CN: 移除由“添加生命池”行动添加的一个生命池。

params.en-US: Specifies a health pool created by the Add Health Pool action. (Health pool IDs may be obtained using the Last Created Health Pool Value.)
params.zh-CN: 指定一个由“添加生命池”动作所创建的生命池。（可以用“上一个创建的生命池”获得生命池ID的值。）

description.en-US: Restores the list of heroes available to one or more players to the list specified by the game settings. If a player's current hero becomes unavailable, the player is forced to choose a different hero and respawn at an appropriate spawn location.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家可用的英雄列表恢复至游戏设置所指定的英雄列表。如果玩家当前所使用的英雄变得不可用，则此玩家将被强制选择另一名英雄，并在适当的复生位置复生。

params.en-US: The player or players whose hero list is being reset.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的英雄列表将被重置。

description.en-US: Respawns one or more players at an appropriate spawn location with full health, even if they were already alive.
description.zh-CN: 使一名或多名玩家在适当的复生位置复生并恢复至最大生命值，对仍然存活的玩家依然有效。

params.en-US: The player or players to respawn.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将复生。

description.en-US: Restarts the match. This action only has an effect after the match has existed for 30 seconds.
description.zh-CN: 重新开始比赛。此动作仅在比赛存在30秒后才可生效。

description.en-US: Instantly resurrects one or more players at the location they died with no transition.
description.zh-CN: 立即使一名到多名玩家在其死亡的位置复活，无需等待时间。

params.en-US: The player or players who will be resurrected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被复活。

description.en-US: Returns the gamemode back to the custom game lobby.
description.zh-CN: 将游戏模式返回至自定游戏大厅。

description.en-US: Enables or disables ability 1 for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的技能 1。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to ability 1 is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的技能 1将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use ability 1. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用技能 1。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Enables or disables ability 2 for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的技能 2。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to ability 2 is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的技能 2将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use ability 2. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用技能 2。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Set the ability charge count for one or more players. Affects abilities such as Tracer's Blink, Junkrat's Mines, etc.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的技能充能次数（如果支持的话）。

params.en-US: The player or players whose ability charge count will be modified.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的技能充能次数将被修改。

params.en-US: The logical button associated with the ability to be modified.
params.zh-CN: 与此技能关联的逻辑按钮将被修改。

params.en-US: The charge count that will be set.
params.zh-CN: 要设置的充能次数。

description.en-US: Set the ability cooldown time for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的技能冷却时间（如果支持的话）。

params.en-US: The player or players whose ability cooldown time will be modified.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的技能冷却时间将被修改。

params.en-US: The logical button associated with the ability to be modified.
params.zh-CN: 与此技能关联的逻辑按钮将被修改。

params.en-US: The cooldown time that will be set in seconds. Max of 1000.
params.zh-CN: 设置冷却时间，单位为秒。

description.en-US: Set the ability resource percentage for one or more players. Affects abilities such as Dva's Defense Matrix, Pharah's Hover Jets, etc.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的技能资源百分比（如果支持的话）。

params.en-US: The player or players whose ability resource percentage will be modified.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的技能资源百分比将被修改。

params.en-US: The logical button associated with the ability to be modified.
params.zh-CN: 与此技能关联的逻辑按钮将被修改。

params.en-US: The percentage of resource that will be set with respect to each player's ability resource capacity.
params.zh-CN: 技能资源相对于每位玩家技能资源量的百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the aim speed of one or more players to a percentage of their normal aim speed.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的瞄准速度设置为其原始瞄准速度的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose aim speed will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的瞄准速度。

params.en-US: The percentage of normal aim speed to which the player or players will set their aim speed.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家的瞄准速度设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the list of heroes available to one or more players. If a player's current hero becomes unavailable, the player is forced to choose a different hero and respawn at an appropriate spawn location.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家可用的英雄列表。如果玩家当前所使用的英雄变得不可用，则此玩家将被强制选择另一名英雄，并在适当的复生位置复生。

params.en-US: The player or players whose hero list is being set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的英雄列表。

params.en-US: The hero or heroes that will be available. If no heroes are provided, the action has no effect.
params.zh-CN: 可供选择的英雄。如果没有提供英雄，此动作无效。

description.en-US: Sets the ammo of one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的弹药数量。

params.en-US: The player or players whose ammo will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家面朝的弹药数量。

params.en-US: The index of the clip whose ammo will be set. 0 is the first clip, and 1 is the second (only used for Bastion's Sentry gun and Baptiste's Heal Grenades).
params.zh-CN: 设置索引处弹夹的弹药数量。0为第一个弹夹，1为第二个。若指定类型不存在，则不进行任何操作。

params.en-US: The ammo that will be set.
params.zh-CN: 要设置的弹药数量。

description.en-US: Enables or disables crouch for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的蹲下动作。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to crouch is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的下蹲动作将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use crouch. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用蹲下。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the damage dealt of one or more players to a percentage of their raw damage dealt.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家造成的伤害设置为其原始造成伤害的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose damage dealt will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家造成的伤害。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw damage dealt to which the player or players will set their damage dealt.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家所造成的伤害设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the damage received of one or more players to a percentage of their raw damage received.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家受到的伤害设置为其原始受到伤害的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose damage received will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家受到的伤害。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw damage received to which the player or players will set their damage received.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家所受到的伤害设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the player who will receive credit if the specified target player or players die to the environment before landing on the ground.
description.zh-CN: 设置当指定玩家降落在地面前被地形消灭时，会被归为地形消灭者的玩家。

params.en-US: The target player or players whose death is being considered.
params.zh-CN: 目标玩家的阵亡将被纳入判断。

params.en-US: The Player who will receive credit if the target player or players die to the environment before landing on the ground. An environment credit player of null indicates no player will receive credit.
params.zh-CN: 当目标玩家在降落到地面前死于地形效果时，此消灭视为此名玩家造成的。如果“地形消灭者玩家”设置为“空”则此消灭不会归到任何玩家名下。

description.en-US: Sets the facing of one or more players to the specified direction.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家面向的方向。

params.en-US: The player or players whose facing will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家面朝的方向。

params.en-US: The unit direction in which the player or players will face. This value is normalized internally.
params.zh-CN: 玩家面朝的单位方向。此值将进行内部归一化。

params.en-US: Specifies whether direction is relative to world coordinates or the local coordinates of the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 确定此方向是相对于地图坐标还是玩家的本地坐标。

description.en-US: Finds or creates an array on a global variable, which is a variable that belongs to the game itself, then stores a value in the array at the specified index.
description.zh-CN: 为一个全局变量寻找或创建一个数组，然后将一个值储存至指定的索引中。全局变量即属于游戏本身的变量。

params.en-US: Specifies which global variable's value is the array to modify. If the variable's value is not an array, then its value becomes an empty array.
params.zh-CN: 指定哪个全局变量的值是要修改的数组。如果变量的值不是一个数组，则使其值变为一个空的数组。

params.en-US: The index of the array to modify. If the index is beyond the end of the array, the array is extended with new elements given a value of zero.
params.zh-CN: 修改数组的索引。如果索引位置已经超过了数组的末尾，则将数组延伸至索引位置，且新的元素值均为0。

params.en-US: The value that will be stored into the array.
params.zh-CN: 将此值存储到数组中。

description.en-US: Sets the movement gravity for one or more players to a percentage of regular movement gravity.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的移动引力设置为正常行动引力的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose movement gravity will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的移动引力。

params.en-US: The percentage of regular movement gravity to which the player or players will set their personal movement gravity.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家个人的移动引力设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the healing dealt of one or more players to a percentage of their raw healing dealt.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家造成的治疗效果设置为其原始造成治疗的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose healing dealt will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家造成的治疗。
将玩家所造成的治疗设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the healing received of one or more players to a percentage of their raw healing received.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家受到的治疗效果设置为其原始受到治疗的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose healing received will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家受到的治疗。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw healing received to which the player or players will set their healing received.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家所受到的治疗设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the health of a player or players without affecting stats or granting damage/healing credit. This action only has an effect on living players. For dead players, use the Resurrect action instead.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的生命值，同时不影响状态，也不造成伤害/治疗。此行动只会对还活着的玩家造成影响。（对死去的玩家，请使用“复活玩家”动作。）

params.en-US: The player or players whose health will be set.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家的生命设为此值。

params.en-US: How much health the player or players will have.
params.zh-CN: 玩家所能拥有的最大生命值。

description.en-US: Causes one or more players to become invisible to either all other players or just enemies.
description.zh-CN: 使一名或多名玩家变为隐形，此效果可对所有玩家生效，也可以只对敌人生效。

params.en-US: The player or players who will become invisible.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将变得隐形。

params.en-US: Specifies for whom the player or players will be invisible.
params.zh-CN: 将要对下列玩家隐形。

description.en-US: Enables or disables jump for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的跳跃动作。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to jump is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的跳跃动作将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use jump. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用跳跃。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the jump vertical speed of one or more players to a percentage of their raw jump vertical speed.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的跳跃垂直速度设置为其原始跳跃垂直速度的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose jump vertical speed will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的跳跃垂直速度。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw jump vertical speed to which the player or players will set their jump vertical speed.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家的跳跃垂直速度设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the knockback dealt of one or more players to a percentage of their raw knockback dealt.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家造成的击退效果设置为其原始造成击退效果的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose knockback dealt will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家造成的击退。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw knockback dealt to which the player or players will set their knockback dealt.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家造成的击退效果设置为其原始造成击退效果的此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the knockback received of one or more players to a percentage of their raw knockback received.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家受到的击退效果设置为其原始受到击退效果的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose knockback received will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家受到的击退。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw knockback received to which the player or players will set their knockback received.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家受到的击退效果设置为其原始受到击退效果的此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the current match time (which is visible at the top of the screen). This can be used to shorten or extend the duration of a match or to change the duration of assemble heroes or setup.
description.zh-CN: 设置当前比赛时间（玩家可在屏幕顶端看到）。此行动可以用来缩短或延长比赛的持续时间，或改变集结英雄或准备阶段的时间。

params.en-US: The match time in seconds.
params.zh-CN: 比赛时间，单位为秒。

description.en-US: Sets the max ammo of one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的最大弹药数量。

params.en-US: The player or players whose max ammo will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家面朝的最大弹药数量。

params.en-US: The index of the clip whose max ammo will be set. 0 is the first clip, and 1 is the second (only used for Bastion's Sentry gun and Baptiste's Heal Grenades).
params.zh-CN: 设置索引处弹夹的最大弹药数量. 0为第一个弹夹, 1为第二个. 若指定类型不存在, 则不进行任何操作.

params.en-US: The max ammo that will be set.
params.zh-CN: 要设置的最大弹药数量。

description.en-US: Sets the max health of one or more players as a percentage of their max health. This action will ensure that a player's current health will not exceed the new max health.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的最大生命值设置为其原始最大生命值的一定百分比。此动作会保证玩家当前的生命值不会超过其新的最大生命值。由地图工坊动作添加的生命池不会受此动作影响。

params.en-US: The player or players whose max health will be set.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的最大生命值将被设定。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw max health to which the player or players will set their max health.
params.zh-CN: 将这些玩家的最大生命值设为其原始最大生命值的百分比。

description.en-US: Enables or disables melee for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的近战攻击。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to melee is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的近战攻击将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use melee. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用近战攻击。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the move speed of one or more players to a percentage of their raw move speed.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的移动速度设置为其原始移动速度的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose move speed will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的移动速度。

params.en-US: The percentage of raw move speed to which the player or players will set their move speed.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家的移动速度设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the text at the top center of the screen that normally describes the objective to a message visible to specific players.
description.zh-CN: 将屏幕顶部正中通常用来显示目标点信息的文字修改为其他信息，对指定的玩家可见。

params.en-US: One or more players who will see the message.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将看到此信息。

params.en-US: The message to be displayed.
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的信息。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The message will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。这段信息会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Finds or creates an array on a player variable, which is a variable that belongs to a specific player, then stores a value in the array at the specified index.
description.zh-CN: 为一个玩家变量寻找或创建一个数组，然后将一个值储存至指定的索引处。玩家变量即属于一个特定玩家的变量。

params.en-US: The player whose variable will be modified. If multiple players are provided, each of their variables will be set.
params.zh-CN: 此玩家的变量将被修改。如果有多个玩家，则每个玩家的变量都将被设置。

params.en-US: Specifies which player variable's value is the array to modify. If the variable's value is not an array, then its value becomes an empty array.
params.zh-CN: 指定哪个玩家变量的值是要修改的数组。如果变量的值不是一个数组，则使其值变为一个空的数组。

params.en-US: The index of the array to modify. If the index is beyond the end of the array, the array is extended with new elements given a value of zero.
params.zh-CN: 修改数组的索引。如果索引位置已经超过了数组的末尾，则将数组延伸至索引位置，且新的元素值均为0。

params.en-US: The value that will be stored into the array.
params.zh-CN: 将此值存储到数组中。

description.en-US: Enables or disables primary fire for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的主要攻击模式。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to primary fire is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的主要攻击模式将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use primary fire. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 指定一名或多名玩家是否能够使用主要攻击模式。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the projectile gravity for one or more players to a percentage of regular projectile gravity.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的弹道引力设置为正常弹道引力的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose projectile gravity will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的弹道引力。

params.en-US: The percentage of regular projectile gravity to which the player or players will set their personal projectile gravity.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家个人的弹道引力设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Sets the projectile speed for one or more players to a percentage of projectile speed.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的弹道速度设置为正常弹道速度的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose projectile speed will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的弹道速度。

params.en-US: The percentage of regular projectile speed to which the player or players will set their personal projectile speed.
params.zh-CN: 将玩家个人的弹道速度设置为此百分比。

description.en-US: Enables or disables Reload for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的装填。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to reload is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的装填将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use reload. Expects a boolean value such as True, False, or Compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用装填。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the duration between death and respawn for one or more players. For players that are already dead when this action is executed, the change takes effect on their next death.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家死亡与复生之间的持续时间。对此动作执行时已经死亡的玩家，此效果将在他们下次死亡时生效。

params.en-US: The player or players whose respawn max time is being defined.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的最大复生时间。

params.en-US: The duration between death and respawn in seconds.
params.zh-CN: 死亡与复生之间的持续时间，以秒为单位。

description.en-US: Sets the score (kill count) of one or more players. This action only has an effect in free-for-all modes.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的分数（击杀数）。此动作只在自由混战模式中生效。

params.en-US: The player or players whose score will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的分数。

params.en-US: The score that will be set.
params.zh-CN: 要设置的分数。

description.en-US: Enables or disables secondary fire for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的辅助攻击模式。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to secondary fire is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的辅助攻击模式将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use secondary fire. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 指定一名或多名玩家是否能够使用辅助攻击模式。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the simulation rate for the entire game, including all players, projectiles, effects, and game mode logic.
description.zh-CN: 设置整个游戏的模拟速率，包括所有玩家、弹道、效果及游戏模式逻辑。

params.en-US: The simulation rate as a percentage of normal speed. Only rates up to 100% are allowed.
params.zh-CN: 模拟速率与正常速率的百分比。此数值不得超过100

description.en-US: Applies a status to one or more players. This status will remain in effect for the specified duration or until it is cleared by the clear status action.
description.zh-CN: 对一名或多名玩家施加一个状态。此状态会持续指定的“持续时间”，或直到被“清除状态”动作清除。

params.en-US: The player or players to whom the status will be applied.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被施加此状态。

params.en-US: Specifies a player to be awarded assist credit should the affected player or players be killed while the status is in effect. An assister of null indicates no player will receive credit.
params.zh-CN: 如果在效果持续期间受到影响的玩家被击杀，则视为此名玩家完成的助攻。如果“助攻者”设置为“空”则此助攻不会归到任何玩家名下。

params.en-US: The status to be applied to the player or players. These behave similarly to statuses applied from hero abilities.
params.zh-CN: 对指定玩家施加此状态。此状态与玩家使用英雄技能时施放的状态效果相同。

params.en-US: The duration of the status in seconds. To have a status that lasts until a clear status action is executed, provide an arbitrarily long duration such as 99999.
params.zh-CN: 状态持续时间，以秒为单位。如果要让状态持续直到执行“清除状态”动作为止，可以输入较长的持续时间，如9999。

description.en-US: Sets the score for one or both teams. This action has no effect in free-for-all modes or modes without a team score.
description.zh-CN: 设置一方或双方队伍的分数。此动作在自由混战模式或没有队伍分数的模式中无效。

params.en-US: The team or teams whose score will be set.
params.zh-CN: 要设置分数的队伍。

params.en-US: The score that will be set.
params.zh-CN: 要设置的分数。

description.en-US: Sets the ultimate charge for one or more players as a percentage of maximum charge.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家的终极技能充能设为最大充能的一定百分比。

params.en-US: The player or players whose ultimate charge will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的终极技能充能。

params.en-US: The percentage of maximum charge.
params.zh-CN: 最大的充能百分比。

description.en-US: Enables or disables the ultimate ability of one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 启用或禁用一名或多名玩家的终极技能。

params.en-US: The player or players whose access to their ultimate ability is affected.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的终极技能将受到影响。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the player or players are able to use their ultimate ability. Expects a boolean value such as true, false, or compare.
params.zh-CN: 玩家是否可以使用终极技能。此处应为一个布尔，如“真”、“假”或“比较式”。

description.en-US: Sets the weapon of one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 设置一名或多名玩家的武器。

params.en-US: The player or players whose weapon will be set.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的武器。

params.en-US: The number of the weapon to be equipped. 1 is the first weapon, and 2 is the second. If the specified weapon does not exist, players will use the default weapon.
params.zh-CN: 正在装备的武器号码。1为主武器，2为辅助武器。如果指定的武器不存在，玩家将使用默认武器。

description.en-US: Skips execution of a certain number of actions in the action list.
description.zh-CN: 跳过动作列表中一定条数的动作。

params.en-US: The number of actions to skip, not including this action.
params.zh-CN: 跳过的动作条数，不包括此动作。

description.en-US: Skips execution of a certain number of actions in the action list if this action's condition evaluates to true. If it does not, execution continues with the next action.
description.zh-CN: 如果此动作的条件为“真”，则跳过动作列表中一定条数的动作。否则，则继续执行下一条动作。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the skip occurs.
params.zh-CN: 是否跳过行动。

params.en-US: The number of actions to skip, not including this action.
params.zh-CN: 跳过的动作条数，不包括此动作。

description.en-US: Displays a small message beneath the reticle that is visible to specific players.
description.zh-CN: 在准星下方显示小字体信息，对指定玩家可见。

params.en-US: One or more players who will see the message.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将看到此信息。

params.en-US: The message to be displayed.
params.zh-CN: 将要显示的信息。

description.en-US: Starts accelerating one or more players in a specified direction.
description.zh-CN: 开始令一名或多名玩家向指定方向加速。

params.en-US: The player or players that will begin accelerating.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将开始加速。

params.en-US: The unit direction in which the acceleration will be applied. This value is normalized internally.
params.zh-CN: 施加加速度的单位方向。此值将进行内部归一化。

params.en-US: The rate of acceleration in meters per second squared. This value may need to be quite high in order to overcome gravity and/or surface friction.
params.zh-CN: 加速度，单位为米/秒²。需要较大的加速度才能够克服引力和/或表面摩擦力。

params.en-US: The speed at which acceleration will stop for the player or players. It may not be possible to reach this speed due to gravity and/or surface friction.
params.zh-CN: 玩家达到此速度后会停止。由于引力和/或表面摩擦力的存在，可能将无法达到此速度。

params.en-US: Specifies whether direction is relative to world coordinates or the local coordinates of the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 确定此方向是相对于地图坐标还是玩家的本地坐标。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Places your camera at a location, facing a direction.
description.zh-CN: 将你的镜头放置在一个位置，面向一个角度。

params.en-US: The player or players whose cameras will be placed at the location.
params.zh-CN: 将下列玩家的镜头放置于此。

params.en-US: The position of the camera. Reevaluates continuously.
params.zh-CN: 镜头的位置。持续重新赋值。

params.en-US: Where the camera looks at. Reevaluates continuously.
params.zh-CN: 镜头望向的位置。持续重新赋值。

params.en-US: How fast to blend the camera movement as positions change. 0 means do not blend at all, and just change positions instantly.
params.zh-CN: 位置移动时镜头转动速度的快慢。0意味着不转动镜头方向，只改变其位置。

description.en-US: Starts modifying how much damage one or more receivers will receive from one or more damagers. A reference to this damage modification can be obtained from the last damage modification id value. This action will fail if too many damage modifications have been started.
description.zh-CN: 开始调整一名或多名受伤害者从一个或多个伤害者受到的伤害。如果想指定此伤害调整，可以使用“上一个伤害调整ID”的值。如果已经开始了太多的伤害调整，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: The player or players whose incoming damage will be modified (when attacked by the damagers).
params.zh-CN: 修正下列玩家受到的伤害（被“伤害者”攻击时）。

params.en-US: The player or players whose outgoing damage will be modified (when attacking the receivers).
params.zh-CN: 修正下列玩家造成的伤害（攻击“受伤害者”时）。

params.en-US: The percentage of damage that will apply to receivers when attacked by damagers.
params.zh-CN: 伤害者对受伤害者造成伤害将调整至百分比。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Starts an instance of damage over time. This dot will persist for the specified duration or until stopped by script. To obtain a reference to this dot, use the last damage over time id value.
description.zh-CN: 开始一个持续伤害副本。此持续伤害会持续一段指定长度的时间，或直到被程序中止。如果想指定此持续伤害，可以使用“上一个持续伤害ID”的返还值。

params.en-US: One or more players who will receive the damage over time.
params.zh-CN: 在下列玩家身上施加持续伤害效果。

params.en-US: The player who will receive credit for the damage. A damager of null indicates no player will receive credit.
params.zh-CN: 伤害视为此名玩家造成的。如果“伤害者”设置为“空”则此伤害不会归到任何玩家名下。

params.en-US: The duration of the damage over time in seconds. To have a dot that lasts until stopped by script, provide an arbitrarily long duration such as 99999.
params.zh-CN: 持续伤害的持续时间，以秒为单位。如果要让状态持续到被程序终止为止，可以输出较长的持续时间，如9999。

params.en-US: The damage per second for the damage over time.
params.zh-CN: 持续伤害每秒造成的伤害值。

description.en-US: Starts turning one or more players to face the specified direction.
description.zh-CN: 开始强制一名或多名玩家转向面对指定的方向。

params.en-US: The player or players who will start turning.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将开始转向。

params.en-US: The unit direction in which the player or players will eventually face. This value is normalized internally.
params.zh-CN: 玩家最终将面朝的单位方向。此值将进行内部归一化。

params.en-US: The turn rate in degrees per second.
params.zh-CN: 角速率，单位为度/秒。

params.en-US: Specifies whether direction is relative to world coordinates or the local coordinates of the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 确定此方向是相对于地图坐标还是玩家的本地坐标。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Forces one or more players to hold a button virtually until stopped by the stop holding button action.
description.zh-CN: 强制一名或多名玩家按下一个虚拟按钮，直到被“停止按下按钮”动作取消。

params.en-US: The player or players who are holding a button virtually.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将持续按下虚拟按钮。

params.en-US: The logical button that is being held virtually.
params.zh-CN: 设置按下的虚拟按钮。

description.en-US: Starts forcing one or more players to be a specific hero and, if necessary, respawns them immediately in their current location. This will be the only hero available to the player or players until the stop forcing player to be hero action is executed.
description.zh-CN: 开始强制一名或多名玩家使用指定的英雄，如有必要，使这些玩家立即在当前位置复生。这名或这些玩家只能使用指定的英雄，直到执行“停止强制玩家选择英雄”动作为止。

params.en-US: The player or players who will be forced to be a specific hero.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被强制使用指定英雄。

params.en-US: The hero that the player or players will be forced to be.
params.zh-CN: 玩家将被强制使用的英雄。

description.en-US: Starts forcing the name for the specified player or players (only works with AI and dummy bots).
description.zh-CN: 开始强制设置指定玩家的名称。

params.en-US: The player or players whose name will be forced.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的名称。

params.en-US: The name to be forced.
params.zh-CN: 要强制设置的名称。

description.en-US: Starts forcing the visibility and color of the outlines of the specified viewed player or players from the perspective of one or more viewing players.
description.zh-CN: 从观察玩家的视角看，设置被观察的玩家的轮廓的可见性和颜色。

params.en-US: The player or players who will have their outlines modified.
params.zh-CN: 被观察的玩家的轮廓将被修改。

params.en-US: The viewing player or players for whom the viewed player's outlines will be modified.
params.zh-CN: 从观察玩家的视角看，被观察的玩家的轮廓将被修改。

params.en-US: Whether or not the specified player outlines should be visible.
params.zh-CN: 指定玩家的轮廓是否可见。

params.en-US: The color of the specified player outlines, if they are visible.
params.zh-CN: 指定玩家的轮廓的颜色（如果可见）。如果选择了特定的队伍，那么此颜色将为红色或蓝色，取决于此队伍是观察者的友方还是敌方。

params.en-US: The visibility type of the specified player outlines, if they are visible.
params.zh-CN: 指定玩家的轮廓可见时，其轮廓的显示类型。

description.en-US: Starts forcing a player to be in a given position. If reevaluation is enabled, then the position is evaluated every frame, allowing the player to be moved around over time.
description.zh-CN: 开始强制一名玩家停留在指定位置。如果启动了“重新赋值”，那么每一帧都会重新为“位置”赋值，让玩家进行强制移动。

params.en-US: The player whose position will be forced. (The reevaluation option does not apply to this value.)
params.zh-CN: 强制设置此玩家的位置。（重新赋值选项不会影响此值。）

params.en-US: The position the player will occupy. If reevaluation is enabled, this value can be used to move the player around over time.
params.zh-CN: 将指定玩家设置至此位置。如果“重新赋值”选项启动，会使用这个值强制使玩家移动。

params.en-US: If this value is true, then the position will be reevaluated and applied to the player every frame. If this value is false, then the position is only evaluated once when the action begins.
params.zh-CN: 如果此值为真，那么每一帧都会重新计算“位置”变量的值。如果此值为假，则“位置”只会在此行动一开始时赋予一个值。

description.en-US: Forces a team to spawn in a particular spawn room, regardless of the spawn room normally used by the game mode. This action only has an effect in assault, hybrid, and payload maps.
description.zh-CN: 强制一支队伍在指定的重生室重生，不管在游戏模式中应当使用哪个重生室。此动作只会在攻防作战、攻击/护送和运载目标地图上生效。

params.en-US: The team whose spawn room will be forced.
params.zh-CN: 这支队伍将被强制使用指定重生室。

params.en-US: The number of the spawn room to be forced. 0 is the first spawn room, 1 the second, and 2 is the third. If the specified spawn room does not exist, players will use the normal spawn room.
params.zh-CN: 强制使用的重生室编号。0为第一间重生室，1为第二间，2为第三间。如果指定的重生室不存在，则玩家会使用正常状态下的重生室。

description.en-US: Defines minimum and maximum movement input values for one or more players, possibly forcing or preventing movement.
description.zh-CN: 定义玩家移动输入的最大值和最小值，可能会强迫或阻止玩家移动。

params.en-US: The player or players whose movement will be forced or limited.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被强制或限制移动。

params.en-US: Sets the minimum run forward amount. 0 allows the player or players to stop while 1 forces full forward movement.
params.zh-CN: 设置向前行进的最小速度。设为0时玩家可以停下，设为1时将强迫玩家全速向前移动。

params.en-US: Sets the maximum run forward amount. 0 prevents the player or players from moving forward while 1 allows full forward movement.
params.zh-CN: 设置向前行进的最大速度。设为0时玩家将无法前进，设为1时玩家可以全速向前移动。

params.en-US: Sets the minimum run backward amount. 0 allows the player or players to stop while 1 forces full backward movement.
params.zh-CN: 设置向后行进的最小速度。设为0时玩家可以停下，设为1时将强迫玩家全速向后移动。

params.en-US: Sets the maximum run backward amount. 0 prevents the player or players from moving backward while 1 allows full backward movement.
params.zh-CN: 设置向后行进的最大速度。设为0时玩家将无法后退，设为1时玩家可以全速向后移动。

params.en-US: Sets the minimum run sideways amount. 0 allows the player or players to stop while 1 forces full sideways movement.
params.zh-CN: 设置侧向行进的最小速度.设为0时玩家可以停下,设为1时将强迫玩家全速向侧向移动.

params.en-US: Sets the maximum run sideways amount. 0 prevents the player or players from moving SIDEWAYS while 1 allows full sideways movement.
params.zh-CN: 设置侧向行进的最大速度。设为0时玩家将无法侧移，设为1时玩家可以全速向侧向移动。

description.en-US: Starts the gamemode. This action doesn't have an effect if the game is already in progress.

Starts granting assist credit toward to one or more assisters when one or more targets are eliminated. A reference to this assist modification can be obtained from the getLastAssistId() value. This action will fail if too many assists have been started.
description.zh-CN: 当一名或多名目标被消灭时，开始将此助攻归于一名或多名助攻者名下。如果想指定此伤害调整，可以使用“上一个助攻ID”的值。如果已经开始了太多的助攻，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: The target Player or Players who will receive assist credit.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被归为助攻者。

params.en-US: The Player or Players whose eliminations will grant assist credit to the Assisters. If the Target or Targets are allied to the Assister, this will be a defensive assist. Otherwise, this will be an offensive assist.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家被消灭时，会将助攻归于助攻者名下。如果目标和助攻者为盟友，则为协助防守。否则为协助进攻。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this Action's Inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This Action will keep asking for and using new Values from reevaluated Inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Starts modifying how much healing one or more receivers will receive from one or more healers. A reference to this healing modification can be obtained from the last healing modification id value. This action will fail if too many healing modifications have been started.
description.zh-CN: 开始调整一名或多名受治疗者从一个或多个治疗者受到的治疗。如果想指定此治疗调整，可以使用“上一个治疗调整ID”的值。如果已经开始了太多的治疗调整，此动作可能会失败。

params.en-US: The player or players whose incoming healing will be modified (when healed by the healers).
params.zh-CN: 修正下列玩家受到的治疗（被“治疗者”治疗时）。

params.en-US: The player or players whose outgoing healing will be modified (when healing the receivers).
params.zh-CN: 修正下列玩家造成的治疗（治疗“受治疗者”时）。

params.en-US: The percentage of healing that will apply to receivers when healed by healers.
params.zh-CN: 治疗者对受治疗者造成的治疗将调整至百分比。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Starts an instance of heal over time. This healing will persist for the specified duration or until stopped by script. To obtain a reference to this healing, use the last heal over time id value.
description.zh-CN: 开始一个持续治疗副本。此持续治疗会持续一段指定长度的时间，或直到被程序中止。如果想指定此持续治疗，可以使用“上一个持续治疗ID”的返还值。

params.en-US: One or more players who will receive the heal over time.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家会受到持续治疗。

params.en-US: The player who will receive credit for the healing. A healer of null indicates no player will receive credit.
params.zh-CN: 治疗视为此名玩家造成的。如果“治疗者”设置为“空”则此治疗不会归到任何玩家名下。

params.en-US: The duration of the heal over time in seconds. To have a healing that lasts until stopped by script, provide an arbitrarily long duration such as 99999.
params.zh-CN: 持续治疗的持续时间，以秒为单位。如果要让状态持续到被程序终止为止，可以输出较长的持续时间，如9999。

params.en-US: The healing per second for the heal over time.
params.zh-CN: 此持续治疗每秒造成的治疗。

description.en-US: Modifies the way hero voice lines sound for a player or players.
description.zh-CN: 修改玩家的英雄语音声音。

params.en-US: The player or players whose voice line sound will be modified.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的英雄语音声音将被修改。

params.en-US: The amount that the pitch of the voice will be raised (up to 1.5) or lowered (down to 0.5).
params.zh-CN: 语音的音调提高（最高至1.5）或降低（最低至0.5）的值。

params.en-US: If true, Pitch Scalar is evaluated and updated every frame. If false, Pitch Scalar is evaluated once when the action executes.
params.zh-CN: 如果此值为真，那么每一帧都会重新计算音调调整的值。如果此值为假，则只会在此行动一开始时赋予一个值。

description.en-US: Begins simultaneous execution of a subroutine rule (which is a rule with a Subroutine event type). Execution of the original rule continues uninterrupted. The subroutine will have access to the same contextual values (such as Event Player) as the original rule.
description.zh-CN: 开始同时执行一个子程序规则（事件类型为“子程序”的规则）。原来规则的执行不会被打断。子程序可以使用同样的情景变量（如事件玩家）的原始值。

params.en-US: Specifies which subroutine to start. If a rule with a subroutine event type specifies the same subroutine, then it will execute. Otherwise, this action is ignored.
params.zh-CN: 指定要开始的子程序。如果一个事件类型为子程序的规则指定了同一段子程序，那么它将会被执行。否则会忽略此行动。

params.en-US: Determines what should happen if the rule specified by the subroutine is already executing on the same player or global entity.
params.zh-CN: 决定当子程序中指定的规则已经在同一玩家或环境实体上执行时会发生什么。

description.en-US: Starts modifying the size of barriers for a player or players.
description.zh-CN: 开始调整一名或多名玩家的屏障大小。

params.en-US: The player or players whose barriers will have their size modified.
params.zh-CN: 停止强制设置下列玩家的屏障大小。

params.en-US: The multiplier applied to the size of the barriers (0.5 halves the size, 2.0 doubles the size, etc.).
params.zh-CN: 此系数将作用于屏障的大小（0.5即为一半大小，2.0为大小加倍，诸如此类），此调整以“开始调整玩家大小”动作所设置的大小为基准。

params.en-US: If this value is true, then scale will be reevaluated and applied to the player or players every frame. If this value is false, then the scale is only evaluated once when the action begins.
params.zh-CN: 如果此值为真，那么每一帧都会重新计算玩家的大小。如果此值为假，则大小只会在此行动一开始时赋予一个值。

description.en-US: Starts modifying the size of a player or players (including model, movement collision, hit detection, and certain abilities). Note that large players placed into complex environments will severely impact server load, so consider also applying the Disable Movement Collision With Environment action.
description.zh-CN: 开始调整一名或多名玩家的大小（会影响模型、移动碰撞、命中判定及部分技能）。请注意将大体形的玩家放置到复杂环境中会严重影响服务器负载，所以在做出此调整的同时应用“禁用与环境的移动碰撞”行动。

params.en-US: The player or players whose size will be modified.
params.zh-CN: 设置下列玩家的大小。

params.en-US: The multiplier applied to the size of the player or players (0.5 halves the size, 2.0 doubles the size, etc.).
params.zh-CN: 此系数将作用于玩家的大小（0.5即为一半大小，2.0为大小加倍，诸如此类）。

params.en-US: If this value is true, then scale will be reevaluated and applied to the player or players every frame. If this value is false, then the scale is only evaluated once when the action begins.
params.zh-CN: 如果此值为真，那么每一帧都会重新计算玩家的大小。如果此值为假，则大小只会在此行动一开始时赋予一个值。

description.en-US: Sets or adds to the throttle (directional input control) of a player or players such that they begin moving in a particular direction. Any previous throttle in direction is cancelled.
description.zh-CN: 为一名或多名玩家设置或添加阈值（方向性输入控制），对其向指定方向的移动做出限制。取消之前所有的定向阈值。

params.en-US: The player or players whose throttle will be set or added to.
params.zh-CN: 设置或添加下列玩家的阈值。

params.en-US: The unit direction in which the throttle will be set or added to. This value is normalized internally.
params.zh-CN: 设置或添加阈值的单位方向。此值将进行内部归一化。

params.en-US: The amount of throttle (or change to throttle). A value of 1 denotes full throttle.
params.zh-CN: 阈值的值（或改变值）。值为1时表示阈值为满。

params.en-US: Specifies whether direction is relative to world coordinates or the local coordinates of the player or players.
params.zh-CN: 确定此方向是相对于地图坐标还是玩家的本地坐标。

params.en-US: Specifies whether preexisting throttle is replaced or added to.
params.zh-CN: 指定需要替换或添加的已存在的阈值。

params.en-US: Specifies which of this action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. This action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.
params.zh-CN: 指定此动作的某个输入值将被持续重新赋值。此动作会要求输入新的数值，并用输入的数值进行重新赋值。

description.en-US: Starts transforming (scaling and rotating) the throttle (directional input control) of a player or players. Cancels any existing start transforming throttle behavior.
description.zh-CN: 开始转换（放大并旋转）一名或多名玩家的阈值（方向输入控制）。取消所有已存在的“开始转换阈值”动作。

params.en-US: The player or players whose throttle will be transformed.
params.zh-CN: 转换下列玩家的阈值。

params.en-US: The player or players will have their throttle X axis (left to right) multiplied by this value before the throttle is rotated to its new relative direction. This value is evaluated continuously (meaning it updates every frame).
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家阈值的X轴（左右方向）将会乘以此数值，然后转换到新的相对方向。这个值会不断被重新赋值（每一帧都会更新）。

params.en-US: The player or players will have their throttle Y axis (front to back) multiplied by this value before the throttle is rotated to its new relative direction. This value is evaluated continuously (meaning it updates every frame).
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家阈值的Y轴（前后方向）将会乘以此数值，然后转换到新的相对方向。这个值会不断被重新赋值（每一帧都会更新）。

params.en-US: After the axis scalars are applied, the player or players will have their throttle transformed so that it is relative to this unit direction vector. For example, to make the throttle camera relative, provide the direction that the camera is facing. This value is evaluated continuously (meaning it updates every frame) and normalized internally.
params.zh-CN: 应用轴向缩放时，玩家的阈值将会被转换为相对此单位方向的矢量。例如，如果阈值转换至相对摄像机视角，则以摄像机的朝向为基准计算方向。这个值会不断被重新赋值（每一帧都会更新）并进行内部归一化。

description.en-US: Stops the acceleration started by the start accelerating action for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 停止“开始加速”动作造成的加速效果。

params.en-US: The player or players who will stop accelerating.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将停止加速。

description.en-US: Stops all assists that were started using the Start Assist Action.
description.zh-CN: 停止所有由“开始助攻”动作启动的助攻。

description.en-US: Stops all damage modifications that were started using the start damage modification action.
description.zh-CN: 停止所有由“开始伤害调整”动作启动的伤害调整。

description.en-US: Stops all damage over time started by start damage over time for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 停止一个或多个玩家身上所有由“开始持续伤害”给予的持续伤害。

params.en-US: The player or players whose scripted damage over time will stop.
params.zh-CN: 停止下列玩家身上程序给予的持续伤害。

description.en-US: Stops all healing modifications that were started using the start healing modification action.
description.zh-CN: 停止所有由“开始治疗调整”动作启动的治疗调整。

description.en-US: Stops all heal over time started by start heal over time for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 停止一个或多个玩家身上所有由“开始持续治疗”给予的持续治疗。

params.en-US: The player or players whose scripted heal over time will stop.
params.zh-CN: 停止下列玩家身上程序给予的持续治疗。

description.en-US: Stops an assist that was started by the Start Assist Action.
description.zh-CN: 停止由“开始助攻”动作启动的一个助攻。

params.en-US: Specifies which assist instance to stop. This ID may be Last Assist ID or a Variable into which Last Assist ID was earlier stored.
params.zh-CN: 指定要停止的助攻副本。此ID可以是“上一个助攻ID”，或一个之前储存“上一个助攻ID”的变量。

description.en-US: Restores the camera to the default view.
description.zh-CN: 将镜头缩放恢复至默认视角。

params.en-US: The player or players whose cameras will be put back to the default view.
params.zh-CN: 将下列玩家的镜头恢复至默认视角。

description.en-US: Stops an in-progress chase of a global variable, leaving it at its current value.
description.zh-CN: 停止追踪一个全局变量，并使其保持为当前值。

params.en-US: Specifies which global variable to stop modifying.
params.zh-CN: 指定要停止修改的全局变量。

description.en-US: Stops an in-progress chase of a player variable, leaving it at its current value.
description.zh-CN: 停止追踪一个玩家变量，并使其保持为当前值。

params.en-US: The player whose variable will stop changing. If multiple players are provided, each of their variables will stop changing.
params.zh-CN: 此玩家的变量将停止改变。如果有多个玩家，则每个玩家的变量都将停止改变。

params.en-US: Specifies which of the player's variables to stop modifying.
params.zh-CN: 指定要停止修改的玩家变量。

description.en-US: Stops a damage modification that was started by the start damage modification action.
description.zh-CN: 停止由“开始伤害调整”动作启动的一个伤害调整。

params.en-US: Specifies which damage modification instance to stop. This id may be last damage modification id or a variable into which last damage modification id was earlier stored.
params.zh-CN: 指定要结束的伤害调整副本。此ID可以是“上一个伤害调整ID”，或一个之前储存“上一个伤害调整ID”的变量。

description.en-US: Stops an instance of damage over time started by the start damage over time action.
description.zh-CN: 停止一个由“开始持续伤害”动作启动的持续伤害副本。

params.en-US: Specifies which damage over time instance to stop. This id may be last damage over time id or a variable into which last damage over time id was earlier stored.
params.zh-CN: 指定要结束的持续伤害副本。此ID可以是“上一个持续伤害ID”，或一个之前储存“上一个持续伤害ID”的变量。

description.en-US: Stops the turning started by the start facing action for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 停止“开始转向”动作造成的转向效果。

params.en-US: The player or players who will stop turning.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将停止转向。

description.en-US: Undoes the effect of the start holding button action for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 取消“开始按下按钮”动作的效果。

params.en-US: The player or players who are no longer holding a button virtually.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将不再持续按下虚拟按钮。

params.en-US: The logical button that is no longer being held virtually.
params.zh-CN: 不再持续按下的虚拟按钮。

description.en-US: Stops forcing one or more players to be a specific hero. This will not respawn the player or players, but it will restore their hero availability the next time they go to select a hero.
description.zh-CN: 停止强制一名或多名玩家使用指定的英雄。此行动不会使玩家复生，只会在其下次选择英雄时恢复可用的其他英雄。

params.en-US: The player or players who will no longer be forced to be a specific hero.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将不再被强制使用指定英雄。

description.en-US: Cancels the behavior of the Start Forcing Dummy Bot Name action for the specified player or players.
description.zh-CN: 取消对指定玩家进行“开始为机器人强制设置名称”的行为。

params.en-US: The Player or Players whose names will stop being forced
params.zh-CN: 停止强制设置下列玩家的名称。

description.en-US: Cancels the behavior of Start Forcing Player Outlines for the specified viewed player or players from the perspective of one or more viewing players.
description.zh-CN: 从观察玩家的视角看，取消被观察的玩家的“开始强制设置玩家轮廓”效果。

params.en-US: The player or players who will have their outlines reset.
params.zh-CN: 下列被观察的玩家的轮廓将被设置。

params.en-US: The viewing player or players for whom the viewed player's outlines will be reset.
params.zh-CN: 从观察玩家的视角看，被观察的玩家的轮廓将被重新设置。

description.en-US: Cancels the behavior of the Start Forcing Player Position action for the specified player or players. Regular movement will resume from the last forced position or positions.
description.zh-CN: 取消“开始强制设置玩家位置”行动对指定的一名或多名玩家造成的影响。这些玩家将从其最后被强制设置到的位置开始进行正常移动。

params.en-US: The player or players whose positions will stop being forced.
params.zh-CN: 停止强制设置下列玩家的位置。

description.en-US: Undoes the effect of the start forcing spawn room action for the specified team.
description.zh-CN: 取消“开始强制使用重生室”动作对一支队伍的效果。

params.en-US: The team that will resume using their normal spawn room.
params.zh-CN: 这支队伍将使用正常状态下的重生室重生。

description.en-US: Undoes the effect of the start forcing throttle action for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 取消“开始限制阈值”动作的效果。

params.en-US: The player or players whose movement input will be restored.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的移动将恢复正常。

description.en-US: Stops a healing modification that was started by the start healing modification action.
description.zh-CN: 停止由“开始治疗调整”动作启动的一个治疗调整。

params.en-US: Specifies which healing modification instance to stop. This id may be last healing modification id or a variable into which last healing modification id was earlier stored.
params.zh-CN: 指定要结束的治疗调整副本。此ID可以是“上一个治疗调整ID”，或一个之前储存“上一个治疗调整ID”的变量。

description.en-US: Stops an instance of heal over time started by the start heal over time action.
description.zh-CN: 停止一个由“开始持续治疗”动作启动的持续治疗副本。

params.en-US: Specifies which heal over time instance to stop. This id may be last heal over time id or a variable into which last heal over time id was earlier stored.
params.zh-CN: 指定要结束的持续治疗副本。此ID可以是“上一个持续治疗ID”，或一个之前储存“上一个持续治疗ID”的变量。

description.en-US: Undoes the effect of the Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines action for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 取消“开始修改英雄语音”动作的效果。

params.en-US: The player or players whose hero voice line sounds will stop being modified.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家的英雄语音声音将停止被修改。

description.en-US: Stops overriding the size of the barriers of a Player or Players.
description.zh-CN: 停止调整一名或多名玩家的屏障大小。

params.en-US: The player or players whose barriers will stop having their size being overridden.
params.zh-CN: 停止改变下列玩家的屏障大小。

description.en-US: Stops overriding the size of a player or players.
description.zh-CN: 停止调整一名或多名玩家的大小。

params.en-US: The player or players whose size will stop being overridden.
params.zh-CN: 停止强制设置下列玩家的大小。

description.en-US: Cancels the behavior caused by start throttle in direction.
description.zh-CN: 取消“开始定向阈值”所造成的行为。

params.en-US: The player or players whose default throttle control will be restored.
params.zh-CN: 恢复下列玩家的默认阈值控制。

description.en-US: Stops the throttle transform started by start transforming throttle for one or more players.
description.zh-CN: 停止由“开始转换阈值”所开始的转换效果。

params.en-US: The player or players whose throttle will stop being transformed.
params.zh-CN: 停止转换下列玩家的阈值。

description.en-US: Teleports one or more players to the specified position.
description.zh-CN: 将一名或多名玩家传送到指定位置。

params.en-US: The player or players to teleport.
params.zh-CN: 下列玩家将被传送。

params.en-US: The position to which the player or players will teleport. If a player is provided, the position of the player is used.
params.zh-CN: 玩家将被传送到的位置。如果此处填入一名玩家，则使用此玩家所在的位置。

description.en-US: Unpauses the match time.
description.zh-CN: 取消比赛时间暂停。

description.en-US: Pauses the execution of the action list. Unless the wait is interrupted, the remainder of the actions will execute after the pause.
description.zh-CN: 暂停执行动作列表。除非等待被中断，否则剩余的动作将在暂停之后执行。

params.en-US: The duration of the pause.
params.zh-CN: 等待将要持续的时间，单位为秒。最小的有效值为0.016秒。

params.en-US: Specifies if and how the wait can be interrupted. If the condition list is ignored, the wait will not be interrupted. Otherwise, the condition list will determine if and when the action list will abort or restart.
params.zh-CN: 指定等待是否可以被中断。如果忽略条件列表，则等待不会被中断。否则则依据条件列表判断是否及何时中止或重新开始动作列表。

description.en-US: Waits until the Continue Condition is true or Timeout seconds elapse. The rule conditions are ignored during this wait.
description.zh-CN: 持续等待，直到“继续条件”为“真”，或达到“超时”的秒数时限。（在此等待过程中，忽略规则的条件。）

params.en-US: If this value becomes true, the wait concludes, and the next action in the action list begins executing.
params.zh-CN: 如果此值变为“真”，则终止等待，并开始执行动作列表中的下一个动作。

params.en-US: If this many seconds elapse, the wait concludes, and the next action in the action list begins executing.
params.zh-CN: 如果达到此秒数时限，则终止等待，并开始执行动作列表中的下一个动作。

description.en-US: The x component of the specified vector, usually representing a leftward amount.
description.zh-CN: 指定矢量在X方向上的分量，通常代表向左的量。

params.en-US: The vector from which to acquire the x component.

description.en-US: The vertical angle in degrees of a player's current facing relative to the world. This value increases as the player looks down.

params.en-US: The player whose vertical facing angle to acquire.
params.zh-CN: 获取此玩家的面向角度。

description.zh-CN: 一名玩家在垂直方向上的当前速度,单位为米/秒.排除所有水平方向的运动,包括沿斜坡方向的运动.

params.en-US: The player whose vertical speed to acquire.
params.zh-CN: 获取此玩家的垂直速度。

description.en-US: Whether an entity has spawned in the world. Results in false for players who have not chosen a hero yet.
description.zh-CN: 一个实体是否存在于地图中。如果玩家尚未选择英雄，则返回结果为“假”。

params.en-US: The player, icon entity, or effect entity whose presence in world to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家、图标实体或效果实体是否存在于地图中。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player has the specified status, either from the set status action or from a non-scripted game mechanic.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否具有指定状态，无论此状态是通过“设置状态”行为获得的还是除命令以外的游戏机制获得的。

params.en-US: The player whose status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的状态。

params.en-US: The status to check for.
params.zh-CN: 要检测的状态。

description.en-US: The player that received the healing for the event currently being processed by this rule. May be the same as the healer or the event player.
description.zh-CN: 根据此规则处理的事件中受到治疗的玩家。可能与治疗者或事件玩家是同一个人。

description.en-US: The player that dealt the healing for the event currently being processed by this rule. May be the same as the healee or the event player.
description.zh-CN: 根据此规则处理的事件中造成治疗的玩家。可能与被治疗者或事件玩家是同一个人。

description.en-US: Converts a hero parameter into a string that shows up as an icon  (up to 4 per string).
description.zh-CN: 将一个英雄的参数转化为字符串并作为图标显示（每个字符串最多4项）。

params.en-US: The hero that will be converted to an icon.
params.zh-CN: 此英雄将被转换为一个图标。

description.en-US: The horizontal angle in degrees corresponding to the specified direction vector.
description.zh-CN: 与指定方向矢量的水平夹角，单位为度。

params.en-US: The direction vector from which to acquire a horizontal angle in degrees. The vector is unitized before calculation begins.
params.zh-CN: 对此方向矢量获取水平角度,单位为度.此矢量在计算开始前进行(归一化).

description.en-US: The horizontal angle in degrees from a player's current forward direction to the specified position. The result is positive if the position is on the player's left. Otherwise, the result is zero or negative.
description.zh-CN: 玩家当前朝向的方向与指定位置之间的水平方向夹角，单位为度。如果位置在玩家左边，则结果为正数。否则，结果为零或负数。

params.en-US: The player from whose current facing the angle begins.
params.zh-CN: 以此玩家当前面向的角度为起点。

params.en-US: The position in the world where the angle ends.
params.zh-CN: 测定与地图中此位置的夹角。

description.en-US: The player that is currently the host of the custom game. This value will change if the current host player leaves the match.
description.zh-CN: 当前自定游戏的主机玩家。如果当前的主机玩家离开了比赛，该值会改变。

description.en-US: Allows you to use an icon inside of a string (up to 4 per string).
description.zh-CN: 可以在字符串中使用图标（每个字符串最多4个图标）。

params.en-US: The icon to display.
params.zh-CN: 要显示的图标

description.zh-CN: 一个值在数组中的索引位置.如果找不到此值,则为-1.

params.en-US: The array in which to search for the specified value.
params.zh-CN: 在此数组中搜索指定的值。

params.zh-CN: 要搜索的值。

description.en-US: Converts a button parameter into a string that shows up based on the player's input bindings. This value cannot be stored in variables.
description.zh-CN: 将一个“按钮”参数转化为一个字符串，根据玩家所输入的绑定按键显示。此值不能存储在变量中。

params.en-US: The button for the input binding that will be converted to a string.
params.zh-CN: 将这个输入绑定的按键转化为图标。

description.en-US: Whether a player is alive.
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否存活。

params.en-US: The player whose life to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的生命状态。

description.en-US: Whether the match is currently in its assemble heroes phase.
description.zh-CN: 此比赛是否正在集结英雄阶段。

description.zh-CN: 玩家是否正在按下特定按钮。

params.en-US: The player whose button to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的按钮。

params.en-US: The button to check.
params.zh-CN: 用于检测的按钮。

description.en-US: Whether a player is using a specific communication type (such as emoting, using a voice line, using a spray, etc.).
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在使用指定的交流类型（如表情、播放语音、喷漆等）。

params.en-US: The player whose communication status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的通讯状态.

params.en-US: The type of communication to consider. The duration of emotes is exact, the duration of voice lines is assumed to be 4 seconds, and all other durations are assumed to be 2 seconds.
params.zh-CN: 考察的交流类型。表情的持续时间为准确值，语音的播放时间视为4秒，其他所有交流类型的持续时间视为2秒。

description.en-US: Whether a player is using any communication type (such as emoting, using a voice line, using a spray, etc.).
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在使用任意的交流类型（如表情、播放语音、喷漆等）。

params.en-US: The player whose communication status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的交流状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is using an emote.
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在使用表情。

params.en-US: The player whose emoting status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家是否在使用表情。

description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在使用喷漆。

params.en-US: The Player whose spray status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的喷漆状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is using a voice line. (The duration of voice lines is assumed to be 4 seconds.)
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在播放语音（语音的长度统一视为4秒）。

params.en-US: The player whose voice line status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家是否在播放语音。

description.en-US: Whether the point is locked in control mode.
description.zh-CN: 占领要点模式中占领点是否解锁。

description.en-US: Whether a player is crouching.
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在下蹲。

params.en-US: The player whose crouching status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家是否正在下蹲。

description.en-US: Whether a player is dead.
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否死亡。

params.en-US: The player whose death to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的死亡状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is a dummy bot.
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否是机器人。

params.en-US: Player to consider.
params.zh-CN: 考察此玩家。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is duplicating another hero. To check which hero, use the Hero Being Duplicated value.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否正在复制另一名英雄。（为了检测复制的英雄，可使用“正在复制的英雄”的值。）

params.en-US: The player whose duplication status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的人格复制状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player's primary weapon attack is being used.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否在使用主要武器攻击。

params.en-US: The player whose primary weapon attack usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的主要武器攻击状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player's secondary weapon attack is being used.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否在使用辅助武器攻击。

params.en-US: The player whose secondary weapon attack usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的辅助武器攻击状态。

description.en-US: Whether a specific team's flag is at its base in capture the flag.
description.zh-CN: 在勇夺锦旗模式下，指定队伍的旗帜是否在其基地内。

params.en-US: The team whose flag to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此队伍的旗帜。

description.en-US: Whether a specific team's flag is being carried by a member of the opposing team in capture the flag.
description.zh-CN: 在勇夺锦旗模式下，指定队伍的旗帜是否在其基地内。

params.en-US: The team whose flag to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此队伍的旗帜。

description.en-US: Whether the main phase of the match is in progress (during which time combat and scoring are allowed).
description.zh-CN: 此比赛是否正在主要阶段（可以进行战斗并获得分数的阶段）。

description.en-US: Whether a specific hero is being played (either on a team or in the match).
description.zh-CN: 指定英雄是否正在使用（可以限定在队伍中或游戏中）。

params.en-US: The hero to check for play.
params.zh-CN: 检测此英雄是否在使用。

params.en-US: The team or teams on which to check for the hero being played.
params.zh-CN: 检测队伍中是否正在使用这名英雄。

description.en-US: Whether a player is airborne.
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在空中。

params.en-US: The player whose airborne status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的浮空状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is currently in an alternate form: Wrecking Ball's ball form, Baby Dva, Bastion's turret and tank forms, Lucio's speed song, Mercy's pistol, or Torbjorn's hammer. For Echo duplication, use the Is Duplicating value instead.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家当前是否处于非初始状态（如D.Va离开机甲、卢西奥使用加速音乐、堡垒处于转换形态期间、天使和托比昂使用辅助攻击武器，等等。）如果要检测回声是否正在使用人格复制，请使用“正在人格复制”的值。

params.en-US: The player whose form to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的状态。

description.en-US: Whether two positions have line of sight with each other.
description.zh-CN: 两个位置是否在彼此的视线内。

params.en-US: The start position for the line-of-sight check. If a player is provided, a position 2 meters above the player's feet is used.
params.zh-CN: 用于进行视线检测的起点位置。如果此处填入一名玩家，则使用从此玩家脚部向上2米的位置。

params.en-US: The end position for the line-of-sight check. If a player is provided, a position 2 meters above the player's feet is used.
params.zh-CN: 用于进行视线检测的终点位置。如果此处填入一名玩家，则使用从此玩家脚部向上2米的位置。

params.en-US: Defines how barriers affect line of sight. When considering whether a barrier belongs to an enemy, the allegiance of the player provided to start pos (if any) is used.
params.zh-CN: 定义屏障是否影响视线判断。如果要考察屏障是否属于敌方，则以游戏开始时玩家所在的队伍（如果有的话）为准。

description.en-US: Whether the match is currently in its setup phase.
description.zh-CN: 此比赛是否正在准备阶段。

description.en-US: Whether a specific player is in the spawn room (and is thus being healed and able to change heroes).
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否正在重生室内（恢复生命值且可更换英雄）。

params.en-US: The player whose spawn room status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的重生室状态。

description.en-US: Whether the current game of capture the flag is in sudden death.
description.zh-CN: 当前勇夺锦旗游戏是否处于绝杀局状态。

description.en-US: Whether a location is within view of a player.
description.zh-CN: 检测一个坐标是否位于玩家的视角内。

params.zh-CN: 检测此名玩家的视野。

params.zh-CN: 检测此坐标是否在视角内。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is jumping.

description.en-US: Whether the match has finished.
description.zh-CN: 此比赛是否已经结束。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is meleeing.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否在近战攻击。

params.en-US: The player whose melee usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的近战攻击状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is moving (defined as having a non-zero current speed).
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在移动（当前速度不为零）。

params.en-US: The player whose moving status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的运动状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified objective has been completed. Results in false if the game mode is not assault, escort, or hybrid.
description.zh-CN: 指定目标是否已经完成。如果游戏模式不是攻防作战、护送或攻击/护送，则结果为“假”。

params.en-US: The index of the objective to consider, starting at 0 and counting up. Each control point, payload checkpoint, and payload destination has its own index.
params.zh-CN: 考察的目标点的索引，从0开始逐渐累加。每个控制点、运载目标检查点、运载目标目的地都有其独自的索引。

description.en-US: Whether a specific player's portrait is on fire.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家的头像是否处于火力全开状态。

params.en-US: The player whose portrait to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的头像状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is on the ground (or other walkable surface).
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否位于地面上（或可行走的表面上）。

params.en-US: The player whose ground status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家是否处于地面上。

description.en-US: Whether a specific player is currently occupying a payload or capture point.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否正在运载目标或占领点上。

params.en-US: The player whose objective status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的目标点状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is on a wall (climbing or riding).
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否位于墙体上（滑墙或爬墙）。

params.en-US: The player whose wall status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的滑墙状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is reloading.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否在装填。

params.en-US: The player whose reload usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的装填状态。

description.en-US: Whether a player is standing (defined as both not moving and not in the air).
description.zh-CN: 玩家是否在站立（既不在移动也不在空中）。

params.en-US: The player whose standing status to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的站立状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified team is currently on defense. Results in false if the game mode is not assault, escort, or hybrid.
description.zh-CN: 指定队伍是否是防守方。如果游戏模式不是攻防作战、护送或攻击/护送，则结果为“假”。

params.en-US: The team whose role to check.
params.zh-CN: 检查此队伍的职责。

description.zh-CN: 指定队伍是否是进攻方。如果游戏模式不是攻防作战、护送、或攻击/护送，则结果为“假”。

params.en-US: The team whose role to check.
params.zh-CN: 检查此队伍的职责。

description.zh-CN: 指定数组中所有元素是否都对指定的条件为“真”。

params.zh-CN: 考察此数组中的值。

params.zh-CN: 对指定的数组中每个元素判断此条件。可以使用“当前数组元素值”来指代数组中当前正在进行判断的元素。

params.zh-CN: 考察此数组中的值。

params.zh-CN: 对指定的数组中每个元素判断此条件。可以使用“当前数组元素值”来指代数组中当前正在进行判断的元素。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is using ability 1.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否在使用技能 1。

params.en-US: The player whose ability 1 usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的技能1状态。

description.en-US: Whether the specified player is using ability 2.
description.zh-CN: 指定玩家是否在使用技能 2。

params.en-US: The player whose ability 2 usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的技能2状态。

params.en-US: The player whose ultimate ability usage to check.
params.zh-CN: 检测此玩家的终极技能状态。

description.en-US: Whether the match is waiting for players to join before starting.
description.zh-CN: 此比赛是否正在等待玩家加入。

description.en-US: A reference to the last effect, icon entity, or dummy bot created by the event player (or created at the global level).
description.zh-CN: 对事件玩家创建的（或由全局创建的）最后一个效果，图标实体或机器人的引用。

description.en-US: The value at the end of the specified array. Results in 0 if the specified array is empty.
description.zh-CN: 指定数组末尾元素的值。如果指定数组为空，则结果为0。

description.zh-CN: 方向性矢量 (1,0,0) 的简写，此矢量指向左方。

description.zh-CN: 由终端用户的电脑所操控的玩家。此值对每位终端用户均不相同，所以只有会影响视觉效果或HUD的动作才可访问此值。此值无法储存在变量中。

description.en-US: The vector in local coordinates corresponding to the provided vector in world coordinates.
description.zh-CN: 相对于本地坐标的矢量值，与所提供的相对地图坐标的矢量值对应。

params.zh-CN: 将此相对地图坐标的矢量值转化为相对于本地坐标的矢量值。

params.zh-CN: 本地矢量是相对此玩家的。

params.zh-CN: 指定此矢量是否接受旋转及平移（通常是位置），或者只接受旋转（通常是方向和速度）。

description.en-US: The magnitude (length) of the specified vector
description.zh-CN: 指定值的幅值。

params.zh-CN: 求幅值操作的矢量操作数。

params.zh-CN: 对此数组的复制进行映射。

params.en-US: The mapping expression that is evaluated for each element of the copied array. Use the current array element value to reference the element of the array currently being considered.

params.zh-CN: 此类别的名字，可以用来找到此设置。

params.en-US: The name of this setting. Must be a custom string literal with 128 characters or less.
params.zh-CN: 此设置的名称。

params.en-US: The default value for this setting.
params.zh-CN: 此项设置的默认值。

params.en-US: The minimum value for this setting.
params.zh-CN: 此设置所允许的最小值

params.en-US: The maximum value for this setting.
params.zh-CN: 此设置所允许的最大值

params.en-US: A sort order for this setting (within the category). Settings with the same sort order are ordered alphabetically.
params.zh-CN: 此设置与其他同类别设置的排序关系。排序较高的设置会在排序较低的设置之后显示。

description.en-US: Provides the value (true or false) of a new toggle setting that will appear in the workshop settings card as a checkbox.
description.zh-CN: 提供一个新的开关设置的值（真或假），会显示在“地图工坊设置”卡片上作为勾选项。

params.en-US: The name of the category in which this setting will be found. Must be a custom string literal with 128 characters or less.
params.zh-CN: 此类别的名字，可以用来找到此设置。

params.en-US: The name of this setting. Must be a custom string literal with 128 characters or less.
params.zh-CN: 此设置的名称。

params.en-US: The default value for this setting.
params.zh-CN: 此项设置的默认值。

params.zh-CN: 此设置与其他同类别设置的排序关系。排序较高的设置会在排序较低的设置之后显示。

description.en-US: The vector in world coordinates corresponding to the provided vector in local coordinates.
description.zh-CN: 相对于地图坐标的矢量值，与所提供的相对本地坐标的矢量值对应。

params.en-US: The vector in local coordinates that will be converted to world coordinates.
params.zh-CN: 将此相对本地坐标的矢量值转化为相对于地图坐标的矢量值。

params.en-US: The player to whom the local vector is relative.
params.zh-CN: 本地矢量是相对此玩家的。

params.en-US: Specifies whether the vector should receive a rotation and a translation (usually applied to positions) or only a rotation (usually applied to directions and velocities).
params.zh-CN: 指定此矢量是否接受旋转及平移（通常是位置），或者只接受旋转（通常是方向和速度）。
